samples.hyp: Ukulinganisa amazinga okufanele okuhlolwa kwe-SARS-CoV-2 kuwo wonke umuntu ukuze kwenziwe ukulawulwa okungenzeka kokubhebhetheka kwesifo eLusaka, indawo ephakathi kweZambia, kucatshangelwe abantu abangenayo imimonyo:
Ucwaningo oluqondile lokulinganisa ngemodeli yezibalo.

Isifo esisha seCoronavirus (i-COVID-19), esibangelwa yi-severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus—2 (i-SARS-CoV-2), e-Afrika siphawulwa yingxenye enkulu yabantu abangenayo imimonyo (noma abanezimpawu ezilula) okucatshangwa ukuthi badlala indima ekusakazeni lokhu kuqubuka.
Isilinganiso kanye nobukhulu bokuhambisa ukutheleleka kwabantu abangenayo imimonyo kusazacaca.
Nokho, izifundo zibonisa ukuthi ukuphathwa kwabo kubalulekile ekulawuleni ukudluliselwa kwe-SARS-CoV-2.

Senze imodeli yezibalo elula ye-deterministic susceptible-exposed-infectious-removed (SEIR) ukuhlola umphumela wokwahlukaniswa okusebenzayo kwabantu abane-SARS-CoV-2 abangenayo imiphumela ngokuhlolwa okubanzi ukulawula ukuphahlazeka eSifundazweni saseLusaka eZambia.

Lapha siye saqamba izimo ezimbili; (1) sicabanga ukuthi abantu abangenayo imiphumela bahlanganisa u-70% wazo zonke izimo ze-COVID-19, kanye ne-(2) abantu abangenayo imiphumela bahlanganisa u-50% kuphela wezimo.

Ukuze kuqhathaniswe, imodeli yalinganiswa kuqala ngaphansi kokubheka ukuthi abantu abangenayo imimonyo bangatheleka njengabantu abanesimonyo, bese kuthi okwesibili, futhi okungenzeka kakhulu, ngokubheka ukuthi abantu abangenayo imimonyo bangatheleka ngesigamu kuphela njengabantu abanesimonyo.

Kumodel ecabanga ngamacala angabonakali angu-70%, izinga lokulinga elihlala liqhubeka nsuku zonke elingaphezulu noma elingalingana ne-7911 ukuhlolwa/ abantu abangu-100000 bekuyanele ukulawula ukubhebhetheka uma abantu abangabonakali beba yingxenye kuphela yokutheleleka, kuyilapho uma kufakwa ukutheleleka okulinganayo, kwakudingeka izinga lokulinga elingaphezulu noma elingalingana ne-10028 ukuhlolwa/ abantu abangu-100000.

Kwabeswele izimpawu ezingama-50%, amazinga okulinga ngokugcwele okungenani angu- ≥ 4540 ukuhlolwa/ abantu abayizinkulungwane eziyi-100 000 bekwanele ukulawula ukubhebhetheka kokusabalala kokubili amazinga acatshangelwayo okutheleleka kwabantu abangenazimpawu uma kuqhathaniswa nabantu abanezimpango.
Ingxoxo neziphetho

Imodeli yethu ibikezela ukuthi ukuhlukaniswa okusebenzayo kwezimo ze-COVID-19, kuhlanganise nabantu abangenayo imiphumela, ngokuhlolwa okubanzi kungenziwa njengendlela yokulawula ukudluliselwa kwe-SARS-Cov-2 eLusaka, eZambia, kodwa kuzoba yindleko ephakeme.
Uvivinyo olukhulu oluqhubekayo emadolobheni amakhulu njengase-Lusaka lunganciphisa ukwanda kwe-COVID-19, kodwa ingabe kuyasebenza?
Ngo-2020, amamodeli ekhompyutha abikezela ukuthi ukwanda kwe-COVID-19 emadolobheni amakhulu bekungalawulwa kangcono ngokuhlola okuningi, bese kuthi bonke abavivinya kahle bahlukaniswe.
Kodwa-ke, abacwaningi bathi le ndlela ingabiza futhi ingasebenzi kahle.
Ekuqaleni kwempikiswano, abantu abaningi ababenesifo se-COVID-19 babengabonisi zimpawu zesifo, kodwa basabalalisa lesi sifo kwabanye.
Ezinye izifundo zikhombe ukuthi abantu abaphezulu ku-50% kuya ku-80% abane-COVID-19 babengenazo izimpawu (abangenazo izimpawu) futhi bangaba sebebophekile ku-40% kuya ku-70% yokutheleleka okusha.
Abacwaningi babefuna ukwazi ukuthi ukuthola nokuhlukanisa abantu abangenayo imimonyo kungasiza yini ekulawuleni ukusabalala kwe-COVID-19.
Babefuna futhi ukwazi ukuthi ukuhlola okubanzi, okusho ukuhlola abantu abaningi ngokungahleliwe, kuthola ngempumelelo yini abantu abangenayo imimonyo.
Abacwaningi bakhe imodeli yekhompyutha ebikezela ukuthi abantu bayeka ukuba sengozini, baqabulana, batheleleka, bese behlukaniswa.
Bagxile kwedatha evela esifundazweni saseLusaka eZambia, okuyisikhungo sebhizinisi elina-airport yamazwe ngamazwe ehlala emingceleni yezwe ezimbili.

Ngenxa yokuthi izimpawu ze-COVID-19 zazibonakala zihlukahlukana ngendawo, bahlola izimo ezine, lapho ama-50% noma ama-70% ezimo ze-COVID-19 ayengenazo izimpawu, futhi lezi zimo zazilingana noma zinezinga eliphansi le-infectious njengezimpawu ezikhona.
Imodeli yabacwaningi ithole ukuthi bekungenzeka ukulawula ukwanda kwe-COVID-19 ngokwenza ukuhlolwa okubanzi nangokukhipha bonke abantu abavivinywe beqotho, ngisho nalabo abangenayo imimonyo.
Bathe bathi ukuze kunciphise inani elikhulu lezimangalo nge-90% kuzo zonke izimo, kwakudingeka ukuhlolwa kwabantu abangu-10% eLusaka nsuku zonke.
Baphethe futhi ukuthi uma sifuna ukugcina inani lezingozi ezintsha ze-COVID-19 lingashintshi, kwakudingeka kuhlolwe u-22% wabantu nsuku zonke.
Naphezu kokuba iZambia ibeke izindlela eziningi zokulinganisela i-COVID-19, amacala abonakala esekhuphuka.
Ukuhlolwa okubanzi kunciphisa ngempumelelo inani lamacala e-COVID-19 ngamaphesenti angu-90 edolobheni elincane e-Italy.
Kepha, ayikho izifundo zangaphambili ezibonisa ukuthi kungaba nomphumela emzini omkhulu kwenye indawo.

Qaphela ukuthi abacwaningi abazange benze ukuhlolwa okubanzi kulesi sifundo; kunalokho, bakha imodeli ephakamisa ukuthi ukuhlolwa okubanzi kungasebenze ekuvimbeleni ukwanda kwe-COVID-19 emizini emikhulu.
Kodwa-ke, baxwayisa ukuthi cishe kuyoba yiyona ibiza kakhulu.
Baphinda bathi kungase kube lula kakhulu uma kuhlanganiswa nezinye izindlela, njengokuvalwa kwezwe, ukulandelela abantu abaxhumene nomuntu onayo, kanye nokwelashwa.
Abacwaningi baseZambia baphinda bagcizelela ukuthi amacala e-COVID-19 angenayo imimonyo abonakala ephindwe kakhulu e-Afrika ngaleso sikhathi.
Ukungenzeki okuphansi kwama-polygenic scores kubantu base-Afrika ngenxa yobuhlukahlukweni bezakhiwo zofuzo nezempilo.
Abantu base-Afrika abameleki kahle kakhulu ekuhlolweni kwe-genetic kodwa banobuningi obukhulu bokwahluka kwe-genetic futhi bahlangabezana nokuvezwa okubanzi komkhathi emhlabeni jikelele.

Ngenxa yokuthi ukulinganiswa okuseqondiswe kahle kokubikezelwa kwe-genetic akukaqalwa ezinhlanganweni ezihlanganisa ukuhlukahluka kwe-Afrika, sibale ama-polygenic risk scores (PRS) ekuthatheni izibonelo kulo lonke elase-Afrika nasemininingwaneni yedatha evela eNingizimu Afrika, e-Uganda, nase-UK ukuqonda kangcono ukusebenza kwemiphumela yocwaningo lwe-genetic.
Ukunemba kwe-PRS kuya ngcono ngamaqembu okutholakala afanayo ngokwemvelaphi kunokufunda okungafani ngokwemvelaphi.
Phakathi kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abanobuzwe obuhlukahlukene, siyakuqonda ukuthi ukunemba kwe-PRS kuphansi kuzo zonke izici kepha kuyahlukahluka emaqunwini.
Ukwahluka kobuzwe base-Afrika kunegalelo elikhulu ekungafani kokunemba kwe-PRS kunokwahluka okukhulu kweqembu elibhekwe phakathi kwabantu base-UK nebase-Uganda.

Sikhompyuthile i-PRS ezizweni zase-Afrika esebenzisa izifundo ze-genetic ezingama-European kuphela versus izifundo ze-genetic ezihlukahlukene ngokwemvelaphi; ukwanda kokwahlukahluka kuvelise izinzuzo ezinkulu zokuqonda ngokunembile kokugxila kwe-hemoglobin kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwamaseli egazi amhlophe, kubonisa ukuguqulwa okuthinta kakhulu okunomthelela okunomthelela wemvelaphi ezinhlelweni ezaziwa ngokuthi zithinta isifo se-sickle cell kanye nokuphendula okungokwe-allergic, ngokulandelana.

Ukwehluka kokunemba kwe-PRS phakathi kwezizwe zase-Afrika ezivela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene kukhulu njengoba kunjalo phakathi kwezizwe zase-continental ezingaphandle kwe-Afrika, okudinga ukuqonda okuhambisanayo.
Kungani singakwazi ukubikezela ngokuqondile izifo ezivela ekuziphatheni kwe-genetic kubantu base-Afrika.
Abacwaningi bathi izindlela ezikhona manje ezisetshenziswa ekubikezeleni ukuthi umuntu uzophuka yini isifo esitholakala nge-genetic ayisebenzi kahle kubantu abavela e-Afrika.
Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi idatha bese isibonelo sezibikezelo ezinjalo ikakhulukazi ichaza i-jini zabantu abavela eYurophu.
I-GWAS database imele "izifundo zokuxhumana kwe-Genome-Wide", futhi izitshudeni zezesayensi ziyisebenzisa ukufuna izimpawu nezifo eziqondene ne-gene.
Eqinisweni, bangasebenzisa i-GWAS ukubala ingozi yezakhi zofuzo zomuntu yesifo noma uphawu.
Kodwa-ke, iningi lemininingwane ye-gene ku-GWAS livela kubantu abavela eYurophu.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi bafuna ukubona ukuthi ukubala abakusebenzisayo ukuqagela ingozi yesifo sezofuzo besebenzisa i-GWAS kusebenza kangcono kangakanani kubantu abavela e-Afrika.
Babefisa futhi ukubona ukuthi i-GWAS ehlukahlukene kakhulu, ngamanye amazwi idatha ehlanganisa ulwazi olukhulu lwezakhiwo ze-jeni zase-Afrika, ingathuthukisa yini ukubikezela.
Lokhu kubalwa kuwaziwa ngamagama esayensi njenge-“polygenic risk score”, noma i-PRS.

Basebenzise ama-computer ukubala ingozi elikhombisiwe yezakhiwo zezinto eziphilayo zabantu base-Afrika besebenzisa i-GWAS, futhi basebenzise amarekhodi ezempilo abantu base-Afrika ukuhlola izimpawu ezithile noma izifo ezingase zibe yimbangela yizinguquko ezigcinwe ezinthongweni.
Lapho basebenzisa i-European GWAS, bathole ukuthi i-genetic risk score yayinembe kakhulu uma abantu benesizwe saseYurophu uma kuqhathaniswa nesizwe sase-Afrika ezintweni eziningi.
Bathe bathi amaphuzuengozi aphansi kakhulu phakathi kwezindawo zase-Afrika ngoba kunobuningi obukhulu bokwahluka phakathi kwabantu, okungafani nalokho esikubonayo ngokuzalwa kwaseYurophu.
Baphinda bathi ukunemba kwe-PRS kukhula njengoba umsuka wase-Afrika ushintsha.
Abantu base-Ethiopia babe neziprofetho ezingcono zezifo ezivela ekuziphatheni, ngoba bafana kakhulu ngokuziphatha nabantu baseYurophu.
Uma kusetshenziswa i-GWAS ehlukahlukene kakhulu ehlanganisa abantu abavela e-Afrika, ukunemba kokubikezela kuye kwathuthuka.
Ukubikezela izifo zegazi kwakuqondile ngokwengeziwe.
Ucwaningo oluphambili lubonise ukuthi i-PRS iphansi kubantu base-Afrika, okusho ukuthi idatha yase-GWAS ibikezela ingozi ephansi yezifo ezivela ekuziphatheni kwe-genetic kubantu abavela e-Afrika.
Kepha siyazi ukuthi lokhu akuyona inhliziyo.

Ucwaningo luchaza ukuthi lezi zigaba eziphansi zengozi yesifo ezivela ku-gene zingenxa yokuthi ama-gene ase-Afrika awameleki kahle kwedatha yase-GWAS, ngakho-ke amanani wamanje e-PRS awasizi ngempela ekubikezeleni izifo ezivela ku-gene e-Afrika.
Abacwaningi bathi kungcono ukusebenzisa idatha bese ihlukahlukene ebandakanya ulwazi lwezakhiwo ze-genetic zabantu abavela e-Afrika.

Ngakho-ke, kuyadingeka umsebenzi owengeziwe ukuze kuhlukahlukaniswe i-GWAS ukufaka ubuzwe base-Afrika ukuze sikwazi ukubikezela ngokunembile ingozi yezifo ezivela ekuzuzeni ezikhona kubantu base-Afrika.
Ababhali balolu cwaningo bevela e-Afrika, e-USA nase-UK.
Ukuhlola kokubona ngeso lengqondo nokucubungula kwe-cytology ekunqobeni i-Cervical Intraepithelial Neoplasia kanye nomdlavuza we-Cervix eNamibia
Kubalelwa ukuthi abesifazane abangama-851 340 eNamibia baphazanyiswa yi-human papilloma viral (HPV) infection engase ibe yimbangela yomdlavuza wesibeletho.
Ukuhlola ngeso lengqondo nge-acetic acid (VIA) kanye ne-cryotherapy kuye kwabonakala kusebenza kakhulu.
Kodwa-ke, amanani ahlobene nethonya lemihlahlandlela yokuhlola umdlavuza wesibeletho awanele.
Lolu cwaningo luhlolwe ukuhlola ngeso lengqondo nokuhlaziywa kwamangqamuzana ekunqobeni izifo ze-cervical intraepithelial lesions (CIN) nomdlavuza we-cervix eNamibia.
Okutholakele kukhombise ukuthi abesifazane abane-HPV, i-cervicitis, i-koilocytosis ne-atypia baphazanyiswe kakhulu yi-VIA.
Abesifazane abadala, ikakhulukazi abanesi-HIV, banesilinganiso esiphezulu sokuxilongwa kanoma yiluphi uhlobo lwe-squamous cell carcinoma (SCC).

I-VIA ibonakala iyasebenza ekuhlolweni, nakuba ukusetshenziswa kwe-colposcopy ekulandeleleni iziguli endaweni yaseNamibia kufanele kuqwalaselwe futhi kusetshenziswe ngemiphumela eyi-positive ye-HR-HPV.
Kunconywa izindlela zokuhlola ezihlanganisa ukuhlolwa kwe-HPV kubantu bezingqondo ezahlukene neqembu elikhulu lokugula (um., abane-HIV, abanegciwane elizibulalayo).

Ukuthuthukiswa kokwamukelwa kokuhlola kungathuthukiswa nakakhulu ngezinhlangano ezamukela imodeli esebenzisa imiphumela yokuxilongwa yangaphambili, imigomo yempilo yabesifazane, ulwazi olusha kanye nokuqeqeshwa okuhambisana nesimo sezinto sikazwelonke.
Abesifazane baseNamibia abasezingozini yomdlavuza wesibeletho kufanele bahlolwe futhi baphathwe ngokushesha.
Izivivinyo eziningi zingabonisa ingozi yomdlavuza wesibeletho kwabesifazane, kodwa ukuhlolwa okujwayelekile eNamibia akuwasebenzisi njalo lezi zivivinyo.
Abacwaningi bacebisa ukuhlolwa njalo, ukuthola izimpawu zokuqala, kungavimbela abesifazane ekukhuleni kuleli gciwane eliyingozi.
Umgogodla womlomo wesbele (umdlavuza wengxenye engezansi yesbele) ubanga ukufa okuningi kwabesifazane emhlabeni jikelele.
Esinye sezizathu ezivamile kakhulu zomdlavuza wesibeletho yi-Human Papillomavirus, noma i-HPV.
I-HPV iwuvayiras olimaza amangqamuzana esibeletho, wakha amanxeba abizwa ngokuthi yi-lesions, angagcina ephenduka umdlavuza.
Nakuba kukhona isifo sokuvikela i-HPV, abesifazane abaningi emazweni ase-Afrika, kuhlanganise neNamibia, abanaso.
Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukuhlola i-virus noma izilonda eziyibangelayo kubaluleke kakhulu kulaba besifazane, ngoba yindlela engcono kakhulu yokusiza ukuvimbela umdlavuza.
Abacwaningi kulolu cwaningo bathi ngakho izibhedlela zidinga imiyalelo efanele nolwazi mayelana nezivivinyo ezinhle kakhulu okufanele zisetshenziswe.
Bengeza ukuthi abasebenzi bezempilo nabo badinga ukwaziswa okwengeziwe mayelana nendlela izinto ezinjengobudala noma impilo eziyithinta ngayo ingozi yabesifazane yokuthola i-HPV nomdlavuza.
Bahlolisise ukuthi zisebenza kangakanani izinhlobo ezivamile zezivivinyo (ezibizwa ngokuthi izindlela zokuhlola) ekutholeni i-HPV nezipontsho.
Babebuye bafune ukuqhathanisa izindlela zokuhlola, ngokwesibonelo ukuqoqa amangqamuzana esibelethweni ukuhlola ukulimala uma kuqathaniswa nokuqala nje ukubheka izilonda.
Babefisa futhi ukwazi ukuthi umehluko phakathi kwabesifazane, njengobudala babo, noma ngabe babe nezifo ezinye njenge-HIV, washintsha yini amathuba abo okuthola i-HPV nomdlavuza.
Ukuba nalolu lwazi kungasiza izibhedlela nama-klinikhi ukusebenzisa izindlela zokuhlola ngokuphumelelayo.
Abacwaningi bahlole amarekhodi eziguli abesifazane abangu-214 ababehlolwe futhi baphathwe nge-HPV, izilonda, nomdlavuza wesibeletho esibhedlela eWindhoek, eNamibia.
Bagxile ngokukhethekile ekansini yomphimbo yesigaba sokuqala, lapho isifo singaphathwa kalula futhi ngokuphumelelayo.
Baphathe futhi ulwazi mayelana nobudala bomfazi ngamunye, kanye nempilo yakhe jikelele.

Ngokuhlola lezi zirekhodi, bathole ukuthi izindlela ezahlukene zokuhlola zivame ukunika abasebenzi bezempilo ulwazi oluhlukile, nokuthi zingase zibe usizo kakhulu ngaphambi noma ngemuva kokuthi i-HPV ibe yisikhutha.
Isibonelo, umdlavuza wawuvame ukutholakala ngokuqoqa nokucubungula amangqamuzana ebele.
Kodwa-ke, izilonda zazivame ukubonakala ngokuhlola nje ngamehlo, kusetshenziswa indlela ebizwa ngokuthi “ukuhlola ngamehlo nge-acetic acid” (VIA).
Inzuzo yale ndlela iwukuthi ivumela odokotela ukuthi bathole izilonda ngokushesha nangokubiza okuncane.

Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi usebenzisa imishini yezokwelapha eyisisekelo esesivele isebenziselwa ukuhlolwa kwabesifazane kwezitho zangasese, njengesi-speculum (ithuluzi elenziwe ngensimbi elisetshenziswa ukubuka ngaphakathi kwesikhumba).
Baphethe futhi ukuthi ukuhlanganisa izindlela ezahlukene kuvame ukunika odokotela ulwazi oluningi mayelana nengozi yomfazi yokuthola umdlavuza, ikakhulukazi ngokuphinda-phinda ukuhlolwa.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, abacwaningi bathole ukuthi abesifazane abadala, ikakhulukazi labo abane-HIV, babekhona kakhulu ukutholakala benomdlavuza, ngakho ukuhlola njalo kungaba kubaluleke kakhulu.
Abacwaningi benezela ukuthi abesifazane abambalwa kakhulu abahlolwe yi-HPV (ngaphambi kokubheka izilonda) ngisho noma kukhona ivivi.
Ukwenza kanjalo kungaba yindlela ebalulekile yokuthola isifo ngisho nangaphambi kwesikhathi.

Ukuqeda, bathi imiphumela yabo ikhombisile isidingo sohlelo lwezempilo eNamibia lokucwengwa ngokucophelela amasu okuvimbela i-HPV nomdlavuza wesibeletho, usebenzisa izindlela zokuhlola ezishibhile neziphumelelayo ukuthola lezi zifo ngokushesha okukhulu.
Ucwaningo lwaluyisibambene phakathi kwesayensi evela eNamibhiya naseNingizimu Afrika.
Inzuzo yokwelashwa ekubeni ne-HBV/HIV kanye ne-HBV kuphela kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

Sinqunywe imigomo yamazwe ngamazwe yokususwa kwe-hepatitis B virus (HBV), saqala ukuqondisa abantu abane-HBV monoinfection vs. labo abane-HBV/HIV, ukuhlola umthelela wokwelashwa nokuqondisa ukuthuthukiswa kokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha.
Simemezela idatha yokubuka evela eqenjini elikhulu labantu abadala abangu-115 abane-hepatitis B ehlala njalo (CHB), esibhedlela seyunivesithi eKapa, eNingizimu Afrika.
Ukutheleleka okuhlangene kwe-HIV kwakukhona kubantu abangu-39 (34%).
Sibhale idatha yesilinganiso, yekliniki neyelabhoratri yesigaba esisodwa.

Uma kuqathaniswa nalabo abane-HIV coinfection, abantu abadala abane-HBV monoinfection babengavamile ukuba yi-HBeAg-positive (p=0.01), babengavamile ukuhlolwa nge-elastography (p<0.0001), futhi babengavamile ukuba esikhungweni sokwelapha nge-antiviral (p<0.0001); babengavamile ukuba ne-HBV viraemia ebonakalayo (p=0.04), futhi babengavamile ukuba nezici zesifo se-liver okuhlanganisa i-thrombocytopaenia ephakathi/eqatha (p=0.007), i-bilirubin ephakeme (p=0.004), kanye ne-APRI score ephakeme (p=0.02).
Izimo ezintathu zomdlavuza weselula ye-hepatocellular zonke zavele ku-HBV monoinfection.

Idatha yethu ikhombisa ukuthi abantu abane-HBV monoinfection bangase babe sengozini uma beqathaniswa nalabo abane-HIV coinfection, okugcizelela ukungalingani okungenzeka kohlelo oluhleliwe ekubhekiseni, ekuqapha nasekwelapheni.
Abacwaningi banikeza imiyalelo yokuthuthukisa ukwelashwa kwe-hepatitis B.

Kucwaningo lwakamuva, abacwaningi bakwazile ukugqamisa ukuthi ukutheleleka yi-hepatitis B (HBV) ne-human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) kungase kunikeze inzuzo yokwelashwa uma kuqhathaniswa nokutholakala yi-HBV kuphela.
ENingizimu Afrika, ukutheleleka okuqhubekayo kokubili yi-HBV ne-HIV kuyinkinga enkulu.
Odokotela kudingeka baqonde ukuthi lezi zinzalo kanye nemithi esetshenziswa ekwelapheni kwazo ziqondana njani, ukuze bakwazi ukuxilonga kangcono nokunakekela iziguli.
Abacwaningi bafuna ukuqhathanisa imiphumela yokuwelapha kwabaguli abane-HBV kuphela, nabaguli abane-HBV ne-HIV.
Kulolu cwaningo abacwaningi baqashwe iziguli ezindala ezingama-115 ezine-hepatitis B ebambezelelayo (CHB).
Baqashwe esibhedlela iTygerberg eKapa, eNingizimu Afrika.
Abanye abagulayo babephethwe yi-HIV (39) kwathi abanye babephethwe yi-HBV kuphela.
Abacwaningi babheke uhlanga, ubudala nobulili, futhi benze izivivinyo eziningi zezokwelapha nezelabhoratri.

Bathole ukuthi iziguli ezazine-HBV kuphela zazinethuba elincane lokuba zithole noma iyiphi indlela yokwelashwa ngezidakamizwa ezilwa ne-virus, zibonisa izimpawu zemvelo zesifo sesibindi (njengoba i-HBV iwumkhuhlane ongase ubangelwe isifo esinzima sesibindi).

Abacwaningi bakwazi ukukhombisa ukuthi abantu abane-HBV kuphela babe sesimweni esibi uma beqhathaniswa nalabo abane-HIV ne-HBV, njengoba iziguli ezithintekile zombili izifo zazivame ukuba ngaphansi kokwelashwa kwe-antiviral ye-HIV, okunikeza futhi inzuzo ethile ekulweni ne-HBV.

Imiphumela yalesi sifundo ikhomba umthelela ongenzeka wokwahluka phakathi kokudlulisela, ukulandelela kanye nezinketho zokwelapha i-HBV uma kuqathaniswa ne-HIV ne-HBV coinfection, okuyisiza labo abane-HIV ne-HBV.
Abacwaningi bagcizelele ukuthi kumele sithuthukise futhi sinikeze isevisi ephephile futhi elungile kulabo abane-HBV kuphela.
Esinye isiphephelo sale ncwadi yisilinganiso esincane sabantu esasiqondene kuphela nelizwe elilodwa nezinhlelo zazo zezibhedlela.
Ezinye, mhlawumbe izindawo zezibhedlela eziphambili kakhulu zingase zibonise umbono ohlukile uma kuqhathaniswa nalokho okwatholwe kuleli cwaningo.
Kumelwe kwenziwe izifundo eziningi ukuze kuqondwe ngempela umehluko olutholiwe kuleli sifundo.
Le ncwadi ibonise amandla okubambisana, ngabacwaningi abasebenza kuleliphrojekthi bobabili eNingizimu Afrika nase-United Kingdom.
Ngokuyisebenzisa isizwe sabantu baseNingizimu Afrika kule ncwadi, kubalulekile engxenyeni yabantu base-Afrika.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, ucwaningo lungasiza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokwelapha ezingcono kulabo abagulayo yi-HBV, i-HIV noma zombili.
Ukuhlola Umphumela Wokungaphephileki Emisebenzini Yebhizinisi Labesifazane eSifundeni Sase-SHIRORO e-Niger State.

Ucwaningo lolu luhlolwe umthelela wokungaphephileki emisebenzini yabantu abenza ibhizinisi zabesifazane eSifundeni sase-Shiroro eSifundazweni sase-Niger, kugxilwe ngokukhethekile ezindabeni eziphathelene nokuqondeneka kwezezimali kwabesifazane, uhlobo lwemisebenzi yabantu abenza ibhizinisi evamile kubo kanye nobukhulu bomthelela wokungaphephileki emizameni yabo yabantu abenza ibhizinisi.

Isibonelo sabesifazane abangu-377 sihlolwe, okubangele ukutholakala kokuthi abesifazane baseShiroro banesibindi esikhulu sokuqala amabhizinisi, banobuningi bokuphikelela ngokwezimali, futhi bahlanganyela kakhulu emabhizinisini amancane naphakathi.

Ucwaningo luye lwatholalokho futhi ukuthi ngenkathi ukungaphepheli kunomphumela omubi emisebenzini yabesifazane abangabaphathi bamabhizinisi ngokulahleka noma ukwehla likapitali phakathi kwezinye izinto, inani labesifazane abangabaphathi bamabhizinisi alizange lihlupheke ngokwehla okukhulu.

Ucwaningo luncoma ukuthi kufanele kudalwe izinhlelo ezinokukhuthazela zokuthuthukisa ukufinyelela kwabesifazane nelisebenzisa lezinsizakalo zezezimali, futhi kufanele futhi kudalwe futhi kuqinisekiswe izinhlangano zokuqapha umphakathi ukuze zilwe nokungaphephileki endaweni yocwaningo.
Abesifazane abenza ibhizinisi eNiger badinga ukuphepha okwengeziwe.
Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi abesifazane abenza ibhizinisi eNiger banesici esiphezulu sokwenza ibhizinisi futhi bazimele ngokwezimali, kodwa ukuphepha ezigebengwini kuyinkinga.

Abacwaningi bafuna ukwazi ukuthi abesifazane abaphatha amabhizinisi e-Shiroro Local Government Area yase-Niger State baphephile kangakanani futhi baqinisekile kangakanani, nokuthi lokhu kungathinta kanjani amabhizinisi abo nokuzimela kwezimali.
Bahlangana nabesifazane abangu-377 kule ndawo bebuza ngezinselele ababhekana nazo ekuqaleni kwemisebenzi yabo, ukuxhomeka kwezimali kanye nokungakhululeki.
Baphóthule ukuthi u-43% wabesifazane bathi abazichibiseli emadodeni ngemali, futhi u-32% bathi kunabanye abantu abazichibiselisa kubo ngemali.
Abacwaningi bakwatholé ukuthi u-85% wabesifazane babezuza imali emakhishini ahlukene, futhi bambalwa kuphela abathi babededelwe yimishana.
Cishe u-56% bathole imali ngokulima, no-79% ngokuhweba.
Cishe owesifazane omunye kwabayisihlanu uthole imali ngokuphetha izinwele, ukubuka, ukunxiba noma ukwenza izinto zokugeza.
Iningi labesifazane (91%) litshele abacwaningi ukuthi amabhizinisi abo athinteke ukwesaba kwabo ukuhlasela abaphangi nezigebengu.
Balahlekelwa imali ngisho namadoda abo ngenxa yalezi zinhlaselo, ngezinye izikhathi kubaphoqa ukuba baphile bodwa nezingane zabo.
Abesifazane baphinda bathi babengenayo ikhono nezimali ezanele zokwandisa amabhizinisi abo.
Abacwaningi babike ukuthi naphezu kwalelo zinga, abesifazane baseNiger baqhubeke beqhuba kahle kakhulu emakhaya abo.
Bathe bathi eShiroro kwakukhona abantu bezizwe nezenkolo ezihlukahlukene, futhi lokhu kwakuhle nakweshishini.
Ucwaningo lolu luqhathanisa imiphumela yabacwaningi abanye ababike ukuthi abesifazane abanalo impumelelo emisebenzini ngenxa yokunakekela ikhaya.
Kunalokho, labo bacwaningi bathi impumelelo yabesifazane abenza ibhizinisi kule ndawo yaseNiger ithonywe kakhulu yingozi yokuhlaselwa yizigebengu nezihlangu.
Abacwaningi baye bancoma ukuthi bonke abanikwe isabelo kufanele bahlangane balwe nezinto ezingenza kube nzima ukuphumelela ekuhwebeni.
Ngokwesibonelo, abesifazane baseNiger kufanele bathole ukufinyelela okukhulu kwezimali, emapulazini nasekuphepheni.
Baphinda basikisela ukuthi abesifazane abasebenza emabhizinisini bangakha amaqembu azobasiza ekuqaleni nezigebengu nezihlubuki.
Amazinga e-Selenium, Copper ne-Zinc egazini likamama ngesikhathi sokukhulelwa ahlobene nezingozi zokubeletha kwangaphambi kwesikhathi okungalindelekile: Ucwaningo lwe-case-control oluvela eMalawi.
Ukukhulelwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi ukukhulelwa okwenzeka ngaphambi kwamasonto angu-37 aqediwe.
Ucwaningo lwenziwe ukuhlola ubudlelwano phakathi kwamazinga e-selenium, ithusi, ne-zinc egazini likamama, nokuzalwa kwengane ngaphambi kwesikhathi.

Kwakukhona abesifazane abangu-181 kulolu cwaningo oluhlanganisiwe lwe-case-control, abangu-90/181 (49.7%) abakhulelwe isikhathi esigcwele kanye naba ngu-91/181 (50.3%) abakhulelwe isikhathi esingapheli.

Izinga eliphelele elikathi eliphakathi lokuhlangana kwe-selenium kwakuwu-77.0; i-SD 19.4µg/L, ithusi kwakuwu-2.50; i-SD 0.52 mg/L kanye ne-zinc kwakuwu-0.77; i-SD 0.20 mg/L ngamanani ebhekisela ku-47-142µg/L, 0.76-1.59mg/L kanye ne-0.59-1.11 mg/L, ngokulandelana.
Imiphumela ikhombisa ukuthi kwakungekho ukushoda kwe-selenium, ne-zinc; kanye nokugxila okuphezulu kwe-copper yeserum ekukhulelweni.
Ukuzalwa kwengane ngaphambi kwesikhathi bekuhambisana namanani aphezulu e-copper ne-zinc egazini likamama.
Ukukhanjiswa kwe-zinc, ithusi, ne-selenium okuhlotshaniswa nokuzalwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi.

Abacwaningi bathole ukwanda okukhulu kwe-micronutrients i-selenium, i-copper, ne-zinc, kubesifazane abazalile ngaphambi kwesikhathi, kodwa basaphikisana ukuthi lokhu kukwanda okuhle kutholakala ekudleni abakudlayo.
Ukukhulelwa kwangaphambi kwesikhathi kwenzeka lapho owesifazane ebeletha ngaphambi kokuphelelisa amasonto angu-37 okukhulelwa.
Ukuzalwa kwengane ibingakabi yisikhathi esifanele kuhlotshaniswa nemiphumela yempilo embi yengane kusukela ebuthweni bemizimba kuya ekufeni.
Kunezizathu eziningi zokubeletha kwangaphambi kwesikhathi, kodwa indima yokugxila okuphezulu kwezakhamzimba ezitholakala ekudleni nasemhlabeni ayaziwa kakhulu.
Lezi zondlo ezincane zibalulekile ekukhuleni komntwana, kodwa abacwaningi bafuna ukwazi ukuthi kwenzekani uma ziningi kakhulu.

Kulesifundo, abacwaningi babeqonde ukulinganisa amazinga e-selenium, ithusi, ne-zinc kubesifazane ababenamabele ngaphambi kwesikhathi, bese beqonde amathuba okuba ukubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi kubangelwa amazinga aphezulu alezo zinto zokudla ezincane ezifundwe.
Abacwaningi baqoqe amasampula egazi kwabesifazane abangu-181 ngokushesha nje ngemva kokubeletha emagulukhwaleni amabili eLilongwe, inhloko-dolobha yaseMalawi, phakathi kukaJuni 2016 noMashi 2017.
Bathumele amasampula egazi elabhoratri eNorway lapho bakhipha khona i-serum, uhlobo oluhlanzekile lwegazi, balinganise amazinga e-selenium, ithusi ne-zinc.
Cishe ingxenye yabesifazane abangu-181 ababenesifundo babe nezinsana ezingazalwanga isikhathi, futhi abacwaningi bathole amazinga aphezulu kakhulu e-selenium, ithusi ne-zinc.

Bese balungisa izibalo zabo ukuze kubhekwe ezinye izinto eziningi ezifana nobudala, impilo jikelele, kanye nomlando wokukhulelwa ukuze kuvezwe imiphumela eyalindelekile yezakhamzimba ezincane ekubeni khona kokubeletha kwangaphambi kwesikhathi.

Baphetha ngokuthi amazinga amakhulu e-selenium ne-copper awazange adlale indima ebalulekile ekubeni imbabala iqale ngaphambi kwesikhathi, kodwa ukuthi amazinga aphezulu e-zinc kwandisa ingozi yokubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi ngaphezu kwesikhathi esi-6.
Nokho, inani elikhulu lethusi laliyinkathazo kubaphenyi, ngenxa yemiphumela eyingozi eqondakalayo.

Ukuba nabesifazane abangu-181 kuphela ababehileleke ocwaningweni kuye kwakhawulela ikhono labo cwaningi lokufumana ngokufanele izingozi ezihambisana namanani aphezulu e-selenium, njengoba inani elifanele lababambe iqhaza lingama-600.
Ukudla kwansuku zonke kwabantu ababambe iqhaza akuphenyiwanga ukuze kutholakale imithombo engenzeka yezakhamzimba ezintathu, futhi i-Body Mass Index (BMI) yabo ayirekhodiwanga.
Lona yilona ucwaningo lokuqala lolwalo olulinganisa imiphumela yeseleniyama, ikhopho kanye nensimbi kubesifazane abakhulelwe eMalawi.

IAfrika inezinani eziphezulu kakhulu zokubeletha ngaphambi kwesikhathi - ngaphezu kuka-18% uma kuqathaniswa namazwe aseNtshonalanga angu-5%, ngakho-ke abacwaningi bafuna ukwazi ukuthi ukudla kudlala indima.
Ukuphatha Kwekhaya, Ukuqoqana Kwendawonye, Nokubusa Kwezwe Le-Pancake tortoise (Malacochersus tornieri) eKenya
Izilwane zibonisa ukuziphatha okuhlukile kwendawo kanye nesikhathi okwandisa ukuphila kwazo.
Ukuqonda le miqondo kubalulekile ekuqalisweni kokulondolozwa nokuphathwa okuphumelelayo ikakhulukazi kwezinhlobo ezisengozini.

Kulesi sifundo, sihlaziye ukuthi ingabe i-Pancake tortoise inekhono lokubuyela ekhaya uma ithuthelwe kwenye indawo, futhi saqalaza nokuthembeka kwendawo kanye nokubusa kwalo mvelo ezindaweni zayo zemvelo eKitui County, eKenya.

Ukuziphatha kwezilwane ezingu-39 zezilwane ezineqanda ezihlala ezikhefini zamatshe ezihlukene ezingama-12 kucwaningwe kusukela ngoJulayi 2020 kuya kuJuni 2022 ngokusebenzisa ukulandelela ngomsakazo, ukubamba ngekhamera kanye nokuhlanganiswa kokuhlola amasampula ezingqikithi kanye ne-ad libitum sampling.
Ezingama-14 zezilwane ezinoboya zifakwe ama-radio-transmitters futhi zathuthelwa emaphethelweni ahlukile kude namaphethelweni azo asekhaya, futhi ukuhamba kwazo nokuziphatha kwazo kwakulandelelwa.

Ngaphandle kwabesifazane ababili kuphela abazilungiselele kahle ezikhaleni ezintsha zokuthuthela, wonke amanye ama-tortoise azame ukubuyela ekhaya, nge-46.15% awo elandela indlela ebuyela ezikhaleni zawo zasekhaya ngenkambo echanekile, ne-15.38% afika nasezindaweni ezikholelwa ukuthi zingaphakathi kwendawo yabo yasekhaya.
Ukubuyela ekhaya okuphumelelayo ngokuqinisekile kubonisa ubuqotho obukhulu bendawo kulolu hlobo.

Ukuhlaziywa kokutholakala kwezikhewu zezilwane zasehlathini kukhombisile ukuthi bekungekho umehluko obalulekile ngokwezibalo phakathi kwenani lezilwane zasehlathini ezazikhona ekuqaleni ezikhewini kanye nenani eliphakathi elikhona ezinsukwini ezingama-162 zokuhlola (F(1,22) = 0.0699, P > 0.05), okuqhubeka nokusekela ukuthembeka okukhulu kwendawo kule nhlobo.

Ngakolunye uhlangothi, imicimbi yokubamba ngekhamera kanye nokukhetha okukhululekile kwabonisa nokuthi izilwane zasePancake zinobuhlangabezana, ngamaduna aqinisa ngokubulala izindawo zawo kwabanye amaduna afika.
Izilwane zasehlathini ezihlala zilahleka zinobukhulu bokuzibona “ekhaya”.

Abacwaningi benze ukutholakala okumangalisayo ngesikhathi becwaninga ukuziphatha kwezilwane zase-Afrika eMpumalanga ezingama-pancake tortoise (Malacochersus tornieri): lezi zilwane zingakwazi ukuthola indlela yazo yokubuyela ekhaya ngemuva kokuthuthelwa ibanga elide.
Ukuqonda ukuthi benza kanjani lokhu nokuthi kungani benza kanjalo kungaba kubalulekile ekulondolozeni lezi zinyoka ezingavamile.
Ukuziphatha kokufuna ikhaya lezi zinkombazana ezikubonisa kubizwa ngokuthi “ukubuyela ekhaya”, futhi ezinye izilwane eziningi zingakwenza lokho.
Ukukwazi ukubuyela ezindaweni ezithile kuvumela izilwane ukuba zibuyele ekudleni, kubalingani, nasezikhumbulweni, okwenza kube lula ukuthi ziphile futhi zizale.

Nakuba ukuphindela endlini kucwaningiwe ezikhonkwane zasolwandle nezasolwandle oluthambile, abacwaningi kulolu cwaningo bathi sazi kancane kakhulu ngokuphindela endlini kwezikhonkwane zomhlabathi (ezifanayo nezikhonkwane zasolwandle).
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi bafuna ukuqonda okwengeziwe ngokuziphatha kwezilwane zase-pancake tortoise emakhaya azo eKenya, ezindaweni ezinamatshe.
Babafunda izilwane njengoba zikuhamba zidla, futhi nakuba ziya ekuphumuleni emaphikweni, noma emaphikweni asekhoneni.
Abacwaningi baqaphele amaqembu ezikhukhula ze-pancake cishe iminyaka emibili, futhi babekela amakhamera ukurekhoda ividiyo yezilwane lapho bengabakqapheli.
Baphinisela futhi abathumeli berediyo kuma-tortoise angu-14.
Lezi yizinto ezincane ezivumela abacwaningi ukuba balandelele ukuhamba kwezilwane, futhi balandelele ukuthi zichitha isikhathi kuphi emini nasebusuku.
Abacwaningi base bebadlulisele amanye ala makhombikhombi endaweni entsha, ukuze bakwazi ukuwafunda kalula.
Kepha, kwakuyisimangaliso kubaphenyi, izinqola ezimbili zaqala ukubuyela ezindaweni zazo zokuqala, phakathi kwa-1 no-2.5 km ukusuka lapho bezihambiswe khona.
Yilapho abacwaningi banquma khona ukuzama ukuhambisa izilwane eziningi ezikude namakhaya azo, ukuze babone ukuthi zizobonisa yini ukuziphatha okufanayo “kokubuyela ekhaya”.
Ngokuthakazelisayo, cishe ingxenye yamasaga aphumelele ukubuyela emathuneni afanayo ayesaphila kuwo ngaphambi kokuba asuswe, ngokuvamile ehamba ibanga elingaphezu kwe-1.5 km ukuze afike lapho.
Abanye abangu-15% bakwazi ukubuyela endaweni ebanzi, kodwa abazange bakwazi ukuthola ihlombe ababethathiwe kulo ekuqaleni.

Abacwaningi bakuthola futhi ukuthi ama-crevices ahlukene ngokuvamile ayenani elifanayo lezikhukhula eziphumule kuwo, okuphakamisa ukuthi izikhukhula zihlala zisebenzisa izindawo ezifanayo ukuze ziphumule.
Izithombe ezivela kumakhamera nazo zibonise ukuthi izigubhukazi ezizinduna zazinendawo yazo, okusho ukuthi zazilwa nezinye izinduna ezazzama ukungena endaweni yazo noma ekhefini.

Abacwaningi bathi lokhu kuyisikhathi sokuqala ukubonwa kokuziphatha kokubuyela ekhaya ezikhonkwane ze-pancake, nokuthi imiphumela yabo ikhombisa ukuthi lezi zilwane zikhetha ukuhlala nokupumula ezindaweni ezifanayo noma nini lapho zingakwazi.
Ucwaningo lwabo aluzange luchaze ukuthi izigqoko zaziyithola kanjani indlela yazo ekhaya, ngakho-ke ucwaningo lwesikhathi esizayo kufanele lugxile ekuqondeni leli qophelo elibalulekile.
Ngenxa yokuthi izilwane ngezinye izikhathi kudingeka zisuswe ziye ezindaweni ezintsha zokulondolozwa, lolu lwazi lungabasiza abalondolozi ukuba bagcine izigqoko ziphephile endlini yazo entsha.
Ucwaningo lwaluyisivumelwano phakathi kwesayensi zaseKenya naseChina, futhi lwanezela olwazini lwethu ngokuziphatha kokubuyela ekhaya kwezilwane ezinjengezinqolobane nezinye izilwane.
I-Pharmacokinetics ye-Plasma ye-Rifampicin enkulu engcolile neyenziwayo nge-Intravenous kubantu abane-Tuberculous Meningitis:
Ivivinyo Elingahlelekile Elingahlelekile
Amanani aphezulu e-rifampicin eyenziwa nge-intravenous angathuthukisa imiphumela ekwelapheni i-tuberculous meningitis kodwa awasebenzi kahle ezindaweni lapho kukhona khona isifo esiningi.

Siqagase ukuthi ukukhishwa kwe-rifampicin yeplasma kuzofanana phakathi kokunisela ngomlomo okungu-35 mg/kg yesisindo somzimba nokunciphisa nge-intravenous okungu-20 mg/kg, okuphakanyisiwe ezilingweni zokusebenza kahle ze-tuberculous meningitis.

Senze ucwaningo lwe-pharmacokinetic oluhleliwe lolwabelo oluqondile oluhlanganisiwe ngaphakathi kocwaningo lwekliniki lokwelashwa okuqinisiwe kokulwa nezifo eziyimikrofoni ebangela isifo sobuchopho se-tuberculous.
Abahlanganyeli abane-HIV abanesifo se-tuberculous meningitis baqokwa ezigulini zaseNingizimu Afrika, bahlukaniswe ngokungahleliwe emaqenjini amathathu okuhlinzekwa kwe-rifampicin:
esinye (ngomlomo 10 mg/kg), esiphezulu (ngomlomo 35 mg/kg), kanye ne-intravenous (20 mg/kg).
Ukubhekwa okuningi kwe-pharmacokinetic kwenziwe ngosuku lwesithathu.
Imininingwane ichazwe ngokusebenzisa ukuhlaziywa okungeyona ingxenye, futhi ukukhishwa kucatshangelwe ngama-geometric mean ratios (GMRs).
Ababambiqhaza abangamashumi amane nanesine baqiniswe ukukhishwa kwesampula ye-pharmacokinetic (umthamo ojwayelekile, n = 17; umthamo ophezulu ngomlomo, n = 15; nge-intravenous, n = 14).
Inani eliphakathi le-CD4 lalingamaseli angu-130/mm3 (ububanzi phakathi kwekota [IQR], amaseli angu-66 kuya kwangu-253/mm3).

Amanani e-rifampicin geometric mean area under the concentration-time curve kusukela ku-0 kuya ku-24 h (AUC0–24) ayengama-42.9 mg · h/ml (isiphambeko sokuthembela kwe-95% [CI], kusukela ku-24.5 kuya ku-75.0 mg · h/ml) ngenani lempi eliqhelekile, ama-295.2 mg · h/ml (isiphambeko sokuthembela kwe-95% [CI], kusukela ku-189.9 kuya ku-458.8 mg · h/ml) ngenani elikhulu lomlomo, nama-206.5 mg · h/ml (isiphambeko sokuthembela kwe-95% [CI], kusukela ku-154.6 kuya ku-275.8 mg · h/ml) ngokuphathwa nge-intravenous.

I-GMR ye-rifampicin AUC0–24 yayiyi-1.44 (90% CI, 0.84 kuya ku-2.21) kanti i-GMR yekhonsentrasheleni enkulu yemithi e-serum (Cmax) yayiyi-0.89 (90% CI, 0.63 kuya ku-1.23) ngokuphathelene nokuphathwa nge-intravenous.

I-AUC0–24 yeplasma ye-rifampicin yayiphezulu ngemva kokuthatha umthamo wemlomo ongu-35 mg/kg kunokuthi inikezwe nge-intravenous ngomthamo ongu-20 mg/kg ezinsukwini ezimbalwa zokuqala zokwelashwa isifo sohlwempu (TB).
Okutholakele kusekela ukunikezwa komlomo kwe-rifampicin ezivivinyweni ze-tuberculous meningitis zesikhathi esizayo.
Amaphilisi omthamo ophezulu angalingwa kubantu abane-HIV abane-TB yengqondo.
Abacwaningi baye baqinisekisa ukuthi kubalulekile ukuqala ukuhlola ukuthi izilinganiso eziphezulu zomuthi i-rifampicin zingabasindisa yini iziguli ze-HIV ezine-tuberculosis meningitis.
Kuze kube yi-3 kwaba-5 abantu abane-HIV abaphinde bathole isifo sokuvuvukala kwengqondo ngenxa ye-tuberculosis bafa ngenxa yalesi sifo, esihlasela uhlelo lwezinzwa.
Abasindile bavame ukushiywa benenkinga ehlala njalo esimisweni sabo sezinzwa eziphakathi nezinzwa ezibalulekile ezivela ebuchosheni.
Lokhu kungathinta imizwelo yabo nokuhamba kwabo.
Abanye abagulayo baba nokuthambatha noma isikhubekiso, noma ingxenye yobuso babo noma umzimba wabo ibe buhlungu.
I-Rifampicin, iyeza elikhulu lokulwa nezifo elibulala amagciwane, liqhelekile linikezwa njengekhapsuli ukuzama ukubulala amagciwane abangela isifo sokuvuvukala kwengqondo.
Abagulayo kakhulu bavame ukubona kunzima ukugwinya amaphilisi.
IRifampisin ingaphinda inikezwe nge-intravenously (emithanjeni) ngesimo esilukhuni.
Khona-ke, inhlanzi ifakwa emoyeni womuntu ukuze leyo ncibisholo ikwazi ukukhishwa emzimbeni.
Akukaqalwa lutho ukuhlolwa ukuthola ukuthi umzimba womuntu obhekene nokwelashwa uthatha kanjani le mithi uma le ndlela isebenza.
Ukwelashwa nge-intravenous kudinga imishini eminingi, ukungena esibhedlela nomsebenzi wezempilo oqeqeshwe owaziyo ukuthi angayifaka kanjani i-needle ye-intravenous ngendlela efanele.
Ngakho-ke akuyona indlela eqinisekileyo ezindaweni ezinqamile zezwe.
Odokotela sebevele bayazi ukuthi i-rifampicin ayithathwa kahle yi-fluid engqondweni, e-spine nasekhanda, lapho ama-bacteria angafihla khona.
Yingakho kudingeka izilinganiso eziphezulu (izikhulu) ukuze kubulawe ngempumelelo bonke amabhaktheriya emzimbeni womuntu.
Kodwa abacwaningi babengabaza ukuthi umthamo ophakeme kangakanani ungaba nomphumela futhi ukhulu.

Abacwaningi baseNingizimu Afrika ne-United Kingdom ngaleyondlela bafuna ukuthola, besebenzisa inani elincane labaguli, ukuthi kuphephile yini ukunika imithamo ephakeme ye-rifampicin noma njenge-capsules noma nge-intravenously, nokuthi imizimba yabo izoyithatha kanjani inguqulo ngayinye.
Kubalulekile ukwazi lokhu ngaphambi kokuba abacwaningi abanye baqale ngezivavanyo ezinkulu, noma ukuhlolwa, lapho bahlela ukunika iziguli eziningi kakhulu imithamo emikhulu ye-rifampicin.
Enye yezinhlobo ezintathu zokwelashwa kwe-rifampicin yanikezwa iziguli zaseNingizimu Afrika ezingama-46 ezine-HIV ezine-tuberculous meningitis.
Okokuqala kwakuwukwelashwa okuvamile kwamakhapsili anikezwa abagulayo njengamanje, okubalwa yi-10mg yerifampicin ngekhilogremu ngayinye isisindo somguli.
Iqembu elinye lathola amakhaphsuli omthamo ophezulu angu-35 milligrams ngekhilogremu yesisindo somuntu.
Iqembu lesithathu lamukela ama-milligram angu-20 ngekilogremu yesisindo somuntu nge-intravenously.
Izi sampuli zegazi zithathwe kubantu abagulayo ngemva kwezinsuku ezintathu.
Abacwaningi base bekeqela ukuthi kungakanani i-rifampicin elikhona e-plasma yegazi labo (ingxenye eyi-liquid yegazi).
Kutholakale i-rifampicin eningi emizimbeni yabantu abaphathwe ngama-capsules omthamo ophezulu kunalabo abaphathwe ngokwelashwa nge-intravenous noma umthamo ojwayelekile.
Ubuningi bomuthi e-plasma yegazi babubufanayo ekwelapheni okuphezulu nokwesigxobo.
Lezi zingxube zaziyinkulu kunokuba kwakunjalo lapho iziguli zithola kuphela umthamo ojwayelekile.
Ngokusho lwabacwaningi, lokhu kubonisa ukuthi impilo yabagula nge-tuberculosis meningitis ingathuthukiswa uma bemukela imithamo ephakeme ye-rifampicin.
Akuyona into ebalulekile ukuthi bayithola njengezithobeli noma nge-intravenously - okubalulekile wukuthi bathole imithamo ephakeme, ngoba imizimba yabo iyakwazi ukugcina ukugxila okuphezulu kwalo.
Imiphumela isekela iziphumo zezivivinyo ezenziwe e-Uganda nase-Indonesia.
Izivivinyo ezimbili ezincane e-Indonesia, isibonelo, zikhombe ukuthi ukuphila kwabaguli abaningi kungenqatshelwa uma benikwa imithamo ephakeme ye-rifampicin ngomlomo noma nge-intravenously.
Kodwa-ke, abacwaningi bayaxwayisa ukuthi ababambiqhaza abambalwa abaye baba yingxenye yalesi sifundo kunalokho ababekuqale bekuthanda, okungase kulimale imiphumela yabo.
Ucwaningo lwenziwe eNingizimu Afrika.
Lusekela uhlelo lokwenza amavivinyo ukuhlola ukuthi kuyafaneleka yini ukunika iziguli ze-HIV ezine-tuberculosis meningitis imithamo emikhulu ye-rifampicin.
Kulindeleke ukuthi leyo nsukuzo isindise izimpilo eziningi zabantu e-Afrika nakwezinye izindawo zezwe lapho isifo sokuvuvukala kwengqondo ngenxa ye-tuberculosis siyimbi kakhulu.
Ukusetshenziswa kwe-compost ne-biochar ndawonye kungayithuthukisa yini ikhwalithi yomhlabathi ogugile kakhulu wasehlathini lasehlane?
Ukuncipha kokunisela komhlabathi kuyinkinga enkulu ekukhiqizweni kwezitshalo e-Afrika eseningizimu yeSahara.
Umphumela omuhle wokusebenzisa i-biochar kanye ne-compost ekuhlweleni komhlabathi ubikezelwe ababhali abaningi.

Kulesifundo, kwakwenziwa i-incubation yesikhashana yaselebhu yosuku lwengu-30, kusetshenziswa amasampula angu-120 g ngalunye lwe-Haplic acrisol ehlanganiswe ne-corn cob biochar (cbio), i-rice husk biochar (rbio), i-coconut husk biochar (coco300 ne coco700) noma i-compost yomquba wezinkukhu (compost); kanye ne-rice husk biochar ehlanganisiwe (rcocomp) noma i-corn cob biochar ehlanganisiwe (cococomp) ngezilinganiso ze-1% w/w amendment: umhlabathi, ngokulandelana.

Ezinye izindlela zokwelapha ekutadishweni kwakuhlanganiswe ukumboza komquba wezinkukhu kanye ne-biochar yekhobho yekhomu noma i-biochar yokuhlutha irayisi (1% ukumboza + 1% biochar: 1% umhlabathi w/w), ngokulandelana, ukuhlola imiphumela yazo ekuphefumuleni komhlabathi oyisisekelo, i-pH yomhlabathi; ikhabhoni ye-microbial yomhlabathi; ikhono lokushintshana kwama-cation; ikhabhoni ephelele ephilayo, i-nitrogen ephelele kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwe-nitrogen etholakalayo.

U-Biochar kanye nokhumulo olufakwe ngokwedwa noma ndawonye, kanye nokhumulo oluhlanganisiwe lo-biochar, bakhulise i-pH yomhlabathi ngamayunithi e-pH angu-0.28–2.29 uma kuqathaniswa nokulawula okungagciniwe.

Ukuphefumula okuyisisekelo okuvela ekompostini yodwa noma ekompostini yehusk yorayisi, noma e-biochar ye-corn cob noma e-biochar ehlanganisiwe nekomposti kwakuphezulu kunokulawula okungagciniwe, okwakufana nokuphefumula okuvela e-biochar kuphela.
I-TOC ekwelashini yomquba kuphela nasekuphatheni okuhlanganisiwe komquba wekhabhoni ye-corn cob nomquba yayiphezulu nge-37% ne-117%, ngokulandelana, kunokulawulwa.
Ukusetshenziswa ndawonye kwe-biochar yehusk yorayisi ne-compost kwandisa i-MBC nge-132%, kuyilapho ukwengezwa kwe-compost kuphela kwandisa i-MBC nge-247%, uma kuqathaniswa nokulawulwa.

Ngamafuphi, ucwaningo lubonise ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwedwa noma okuhlangene komquba kanye ne-biochar, noma i-biochar ehlanganisiwe, kuwuthuthukisile umgangatho womhlabathi njenge-pH yomhlabathi ne-MBC, futhi kwakhuthaze ukuzinza kwe-C yomhlabathi ngokuthuthukiswa kwe-TOC nokunciphisa ukulahleka kwe-C yomhlabathi ngokuphefumula okuyisisekelo.
I-Biochar nekhompost zithuthukisa ikhwalithi yomhlabathi wemifino.

Ucwaningo lolu luphenye indlela i-biochar, into ezinzile kakhulu, ecebile ngekhabhoni, eyenziwe ngezinto ezihlala zilahlwa, ingasetshenziswa ngayo ukuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yomhlabathi e-Afrika eseningizimu yeSahara.
Ucwaningo luthole ukuthi i-biochar iyayithuthukisa ikhwalithi yomhlabathi ngendlela efanayo nezindlela ezihlukile eziyizindleko kakhulu futhi azitholakali kalula.
Esinye sezinkinga ezinkulu eziqala ukukhiqizwa kwezitshalo e-Afrika eseningizimu ye-Sahara yindlela ukwehla kokukhula komhlabathi.
Ukuthuthuka komhlabathi kungaletha isivuno esihle sezitshalo, okungaphumela ekunciphiseni ubumpofu basemakhaya nokubuyiselwa emuva kokonakala kwemithombo yemvelo.
Ucwaningo lubonise ukuthi i-biochar, into ezinzile kakhulu, ecebile ngekhabhoni, ingasetshenziswa ukuthuthukisa ukunotha komhlabathi.
I-Biochar iyimikhiqizo evela ekushiseni izinto eziphilayo, noma i-biomass, ngaphansi komoya omncane noma ongenayo.
Kuye kwabonakala ukuthi i-biochar iyandisa indawo ebushelelezi yomhlabathi, iyandisa ukufinyeleleka kwamanzi nomoya, futhi isebenze izilwanyana ezincani emhlabatini.

Lolu cwaningo luhlolwe umphumela we-biochar ne-compost ekulinganisweni lomhlabathi usebenzisa izibonakaliso ezinjengokuphefumula komhlabathi, i-pH yomhlabathi, ukuba khona kwamagciwane, inani lekhaboni, kanye nenani lenayithrojeni elikhona.

Abacwaningi benze ama-biochar ezikhukhula zekhabhisi, iziqu zekhokhothi kanye nezikhukhula zesisayisi besebenzisa i-pyrolysis, okuhilela ukushisa izinto eziphilayo ngaphandle komoya, ku-450 °C esiqandisini esenziwe endaweni.
Abacwaningi benze i-biochar yezinqwa zeziqu zekhokho besebenzisa i-pyrolysis ku-300 °C naku-700 °C.
Abacwaningi base behlanganisa amasampula omhlabathi ahlanganisiwe ne-biochar izinsuku ezingu-30.

Isampula ngayinye yayinawo umhlabathi okhethekile olungiselelwe okuthiwa yi-Haplic acrisol, owakuhlanganiswa nezinhlanganisela ezahlukene ze-biochar ezenziwe ngomsila wekhabhisi, ibhulukwe lerayisi noma isigqoko senkuku, kanye nomanyolo wezinkukhu.
Ezinye izibonelo zibandakanya ukuxuba komhlabathi nomanyolo wezinkukhu, kanye ne-biochar yokufafaza irayisi, ne-biochar ye-corn cob, ngokulandelana.
Isampula ngayinye yayina-1% ye-compost, i-1% ngayinye ye-biochar, ukuze abacwaningi bakwazi ukuhlola umphumela wengxube ngayinye ekulinganisweni lomhlabathi.

Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi ukwengeza i-biochar ne-compost ethonjeni, ngokwahlukana noma ndawonye, kwakhuphula inani le-pH yetho njengeyunithi ezi-0.28–2.29 ze-pH, uma kuqhathaniswa nethonjana elingaxutshwanga.
Ukuwanda kwe-pH kusho ukuthi umhlabathi ube mncane ukuba buhlungu.

Ucwaningo luthole ukuthi ukuphefumula okuyisisekelo, noma inani elincane le-carbon dioxide elikhishwa yithaka, likhulile lapho kunikwa ikhomposta kuphela, noma lapho ikhomposta ixutshwe ne-rice husk, noma i-corn cob biochar noma i-biochars ehlanganisiwe.
Izingcezu zomhlabathi zikhombise ukwanda okuyi-37% kokubola komthombo wemvelo lapho kusetshenziswa umanyolo wedwa, kanye nokukhula kwe-117% lapho i-corn cob biochar ihlanganiswa nomanyolo.

Inani lomsebenzi wama-microorganism likhuphuke ngo-132% lapho umhlabathi wawunomgqomo womquba kanye ne-rice husk biochar, uma kuqhathaniswa nokukhula ngo-247% emasampuleni omhlabathi ayenomquba kuphela.
Imiphumela yocwaningo lolu ikhombisa ukuthi kungenzeka ukunciphisa ukubamba komhlabathi usebenzisa i-biochar, elula futhi iyathengwa kalula.
Lokhu kuphambene nokuqeqeshwa okunye kokufaka ilayimu emhlabathini, okubiza futhi akunakutholakala kalula kubalimi abancinyane e-Afrika eseningizimu kweSahara.
Inethiwekhi ye-Fibrin Fibre Engaqondakaliyo ye-Arthritis ye-Rheumatoid kanye nobudlelwano bayo nokuzenzela ubuhlungu, ukuvuvukala, kanye ne-Thrombosis.
Ingozi yemicimbi ye-cardiovascular kubantu abane-RA ikhuphuka kakhulu ngenxa yokuvuvukala komzimba wonke.
Imiphumela ehambisanayo yokuhlanganiswa kwe-autoimmune-associated citrullination esakhiweni nasemandleni okubopha igazi le-fibrin(ogen) isalungile.

Ngakho-ke saqhathanisa izikhombisi zomsebenzi wezinsimbi zegazi, ukuvuvukala, ukuhlanganiswa kwegazi kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwe-fibrin clot kubantu abane-RA nabantu abaphilile, saqhathanisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwemiphumela.
Izinhlanzi zegazi zibuthusiwe kubantu abangu-30 abane-RA kanye nabantu abangama-25 abaphilile abafanayo ngobudala nobulili.
Amazinga e-SAA, i-CRP, i-ICAM-1 ne-VCAM-1 alinganisiwe kusetshenziswa i-sandwich immunoassay.
Ukuqina kwegazi lonke kuhlolwe kusetshenziswa i-Thromboelastography.
Ukuxhumana kwamanethiwekhi e-fibrin kanye nesakhiwo sefayibha kuhlolwe usebenzisa i-Scanning Electron Microscopy.
Ukubona nokuqapha ukwanda kwe-citrullination ezigqepheni ze-fibrin ezakhiwe kwenziwe ngokusebenzisa i-antibody ye-Citrulline enombala olukhanyayo nge-Confocal Microscopy.
Amazinga e-SAA, i-CRP ne-ICAM-1 aphakanyisiwe kakhulu kubantu abane-RA uma kuqhathaniswa neqembu lokuqhathanisa.

Izilinganiso ze-TEG ezihlobene nokuqala kokugqwala igazi (R ne-K), izinga lokuxhumana kwe-fibrin (i-α-Angle), kanye nesikhathi sokufinyelela ekukhiqizweni okukhulu kwe-thrombus (TMRTG) kunciphisiwe kubantu abane-RA.
Izilinganiso eziphathelene namandla e-clot (MA, MRTG, TGG) azange zihluke ngokomibalo phakathi kwe-RA namaqondisi.
Ukuboniswa kwemodel ye-logistic regression kwakhombisa ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwezinto ezisabela ezigabeni ezibuhlungu (CRP, SAA) nezinsimbi ze-TEG kunamamaki okusebenza kwe-endothelial.

Ukuhlaziywa nge-microscope kwembule izinhlanganisela ezinzima zefayibha zefayibhini ezinzima kubantu abane-RA uma kuqathaniswa nokulawula [i-median (i-interquartile range) 214 (170-285) vs 120 (100-144) nm ngokulandelana, p<0.0001, i-Odds ratio=22.7).
Ukutholwa kwezindawo eziningi ezi-citrullinated ngaphakathi kwemizimba ye-fibrin clot kubantu abane-RA, okwakuncane kakhulu emasampuleni okulawula (p<0.05, OR=2.2).
Iziguli ezine-RA esebenzayo zibonisa iphrofayili yokugqwala igazi engalingani nemiphumela ejwayelekile ehlobene nezinye izimo zokuvuvukala.

Ukuguqulwa kokwakheka kwamaphothini yi-citrullination ehambisana nokuhlushwa yi-autoimmune kungadlala indima ekuqondeni ukwakheka kwe-fibrin kanye nethuba lokufaka ingozi enkulu yokuthrombosis kubantu abane-RA.
Ukugandeka kwegazi kubantu abane-arthritis kungachaza ingozi yabo ephakeme yokuthola isifo senhliziyo, noma isifo sobuchopho.
Ucwaningo olusha olukhona nge-rheumatoid arthritis luhlinzeke ngokuqonda okungcono ngokuxhumana okungenzeka phakathi kwalesi simo kanye nengozi enkulu yesifo senhliziyo.
Ukuvuvukala kwamajozi (RA) kuyisimo esibuhlungu nesibulalayo sokuziphatha komzimba, esihambisana nokuvuvukala kwamajozi nakubunye ubukhulu bomzimba.
Sekuyisikhathi eside manje, ososayensi bayazi ukuthi labo abane lesifo banengozi engu-50% ephakeme yokuba nezifo zesisu (CVD) – njengokuqhaqhazela noma ukuhlasela kwenhliziyo.
Iphuzu eliyisihluthulelo kulowo mngcipheko iwukuthi ukuvuvukala kunethonya kanjani inqubo yokugqwala kwegazi.
Kulesifundo, abacwaningi bahlolisise lobu budlelwano, ukuthola ukuthi kungani ngempela i-RA ikhuphula ingozi ye-CVD.
Ngokuqondile, abacwaningi bahlole imiphumela yokuqina nokuguqulwa kwesakhiwo kumaprotheni athile ahlobene nokuqina kwegazi, okuthiwa yi-fibrin.

Lezi zikhombikazi zikhona njengezintambo ezinde ezakha “umsebenzi” oyisisekelo weziqephu zegazi, ngakho noma yikuphi ukuguqulwa kwe-fibrins ngokwazo kungaba nemiphumela emibi ekuqinisweni kwegazi ngokujwayelekile.
Abacwaningi baqathanisile amasampula egazi abantu abane-RA namasampula abantu abaphilile.
Kulawo wonke amacala, abacwaningi babefuna “izimpawu” egazini ezibonisa ukuvuvukala, kanye nanoma yimaphi umehluko ongajwayelekile ekuqinisweni okujwayelekile kwegazi okungandisa ingozi ye-CVD.
Ama-clots ngokwawo nawo ahlolwe nge-microscope, ukuze kutholakale noma yiziphi izinguquko esakhiweni samaprotheni abo e-fibrin.
Abacwaningi baphawula ukuthi izicubu zabantu abane-RA zakha ngokushesha kunalabo abaphilile, nokuthi izinhlanganisela zeprotheni ezazenziwe nazo zazikhulu kakhulu kunama-fibrins avamile.
Kwakukhona nezinguquko ku-amino acids ezenza amaprotheni e-fibrin, okwenza aqalise impendulo yomzimba yokuvikela, okubangele ukuvuvukala okwengeziwe.

Abaphandi abanye baye baphawula izinguquko esakhiweni se-amino acid yama-fibrin ezingqondweni zabantu abane-RA ngaphambili, kodwa lokhu kuyisikhathi sokuqala abaphandi bebona umphumela ofanayo egazini.

Uma kuhlanganiswa nezinye izinguquko ezibonwe ezigqepheni zegazi, okutholakele kungasiza ososayensi ukuthi bathuthukise ukuqonda okujulile kokuthi ubudlelwano phakathi kwe-RA ne-CVD bunjani, nokuthi ungazibona kanjani izimpawu zokuqala zalezi zifo.
Nakuba lezi zimpumelelo zokuqala zithembisayo, kubalulekile ukuphawula ukuthi inani lesampula yocwaningo lalingakancane ngokulinganisa.

Abacwaningi baphinda bakhuluma ukuthi indlela abayisebenzisile yokubona ukuguqulwa kwama-amino acid eprotheni nayo ingase ibe iqoqe imiphumela evela ezintweni ezingahlobene, okusho ukuthi kuzodingeka ukuhlolwa okuqondile okuqondene nama-fibrins ukuqinisekisa umphumela esikhathini esizayo.

Ekugcineni, ukuqonda izixhumani eziyinkimbinkimbi phakathi kwe-RA nokungena engozini enkulu ye-CVD kungathuthukisa imiphumela kubantu abane-RA njengoba sifunda ukubona nokuphatha lezi zifo ngokuphumelelayo.
Abacwaningi baseNingizimu Afrika, eDenmark nase-United Kingdom babeqoqe kuleli cwaningo, elalixhaswe yi-South African Medical Research Council.
Izibikezelo zezimo zezulu zasemanzini zabasebenzisi bolwandle lwasemgwaqweni – imibono, ukusetshenziswa nokusetshenziswa kwazo.
Ucwaningo olukhona luhlosile ukubhekana nokungafani phakathi kwesayensi nabantu, ngendlela yokungafani okungenzeka kokunikezwa nokuthandwa kolwazi, okwaziwa ngokuthi yi-usability gap.
Kulesi simo, sihlola ukubaluleka kolwazi lwemozulu yolwandle (metocean) njengoba kubonakala kubasebenzisi emazweni amabili eNingizimu Hemispha:
iNingizimu Afrika neNyuzilani.
Lapha, ukugxila akuyona kuphela emibonweni, ukusetshenziswa nokusetshenziswa kokubikezela kwemicimbi ehlasimulisayo, kodwa kunokugxila ekubeni nokubandakanyeka kokubikezela okuvamile, okujwayelekile.
Ucwaningo lwenziwe ngokusebenzisa uphendulo, oluhlelwe ngemibuzo yokucwaninga emithathu.

Imibuzo yocwaningo ihlanganisa izindaba ezihlukahlukene kusukela ekusebenzeni okulula kwemishini yokubikezela, ukunemba nokuzinza, ukusetshenziswa kalula, idumela lezikhungo, nokungabaza okuhlobene noshintsho lwesimo sezulu (ukubala ezimbalwa nje).
Imibuzo eku-inthanethi yasabalaliswa kabanzi ukuze ihlanganise abasebenzisi abangokuzijabulisa nabangokurhweba.
Ucwaningo luye lwasebenza ekubeniqonde amasiko okwenza izinqumo angase abe nethonya elikhethekile ezidingweni zolwazi lwabasebenzisi bolwandle lwasemgwaqeni.

Uhlalutyo lweSivumelwano Sokwazi Lomphakathi (CCA) lusetshenziswe ukuphenya ukuqondana okuhlanganyelwe kanye nokuhlukahluka ekuqondeni phakathi kweqembu eliphelele labaphenduli kanye nasemagqabeni ahlukaniswe ngezigaba nangezwe.
Sithole amazinga ahlukahlukene okuvumelana eqenjini lonke (abahlanganyeli belizwe zombili kanye nawo wonke amasekhta aqoqwe) uma kuqhathaniswa namaqembu ahlukene abasebenzisi.

Bonke abahlanganyeli behlangene babonisa ukuvumelana okuvamile komphakathi ngokuqondene nezindaba ezazibekwe, kodwa ngezinye izinguquko zemibono ezingeni lezizwe, okuphakamisa imikhakha yomphakathi engaba khona.

Uma sihlaziya amaqembu asezindaweni zasezweni nasezikhathini ezahlukene ngokwahlukana, sathola ukuvumelana okuhambelanayo kakhulu kombono wamasiko eqenjini labasebenzisi baseNingizimu Afrika, ngokuvumelana okukhulu kungakhathaliseki ukuhlanganyela kwezindawo.
Iqembu labasebenzisi bezentengiselwano lase-New Zealand lalihambisana kakhulu nabanye abantu abancane.
Sixoxoxa ngemiphumela evela kwimithombo yethu mayelana nezici ezibalulekile ekusetshenzisweni kwezinsizakalo, ngakho-ke ekukhiqizweni kokubikezela okuqakathekile.
Kunezinto eziningi ezibalulekile zeziprofetho ezisekelwe ezesayensi esikhathini esizayo ezicatshangelwa futhi, kucabangwa imiphumela yoshintsho lwemozulu okulindelekile.
Siphetha ngokuncoma umdwebo wemicabango ukuze kugqamise ukusebenzisana okubalulekile phakathi kokubambisana ekukhiqizeni iziprofetho nokulunga/ukuhambisana kwesayensi.
AbaseNingizimu Afrika, abaseNew Zealand bathemba izibikezelo zesimo sezulu olwandle.

AbaseNingizimu Afrika nabaseNew Zealand abasebenza futhi bahlala emagqumeni basuselwa ezinsizakalweni zokubikezela isimo sezulu ezilula ukuzisebenzisa, futhi ezihlale zinikeza ukubikezela okuchukumisayo.
Amasevisi kazwelonke okubikezela isimo sezulu namawebhusayithi amaningi ezohwebo anikeza ukubikezela ngesimo sezulu esizayo.
Bayazama ukuba nembala nangokusebenziseka ngangokunokwenzeka.
Isayensi enkulu kanye nokucabanga kwesayensi kungenela kulobu buprofetho.

Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi bakhetha ukubheka indlela abantu baseNingizimu Afrika naseNew Zealand abasebenzisa ngayo izinsizakalo zokubikezela – womabili amazwe anamahlathi amade, kodwa anabemi abahlukene kakhulu neemeko zasemahlathini.
Babefisa ukwazi ukuthi kaningi kangakanani laba bantu basemgodini belusebenzisa izinsizakalo zokubikezela zezwe noma zezohwebo, ngamabanga aphi nokuthi ngabe bazithole zilusizo nezinokwethenjwa.
Lezi yizinto ezibalulekile uma kubhekwa ukuthi ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu esikhathini esizayo kungathinta kanjani ukuqagela kwesimo sezulu.
Imibuzo eku-inthanethi iphendulwe yi-31 yaseNingizimu Afrika ne-126 yaseNew Zealand.

Lokhu kwakuhlanganisa abantu abasebenzisa izibikezelo zezulu ngenxa yemisebenzi yabo (umzekelo abalobi kanye nezinhlangano zokusesha nokusindisa), nabanye abahlanganyela emidlalweni ye-ocean kanye nemisebenzi yokuphumula njengokugibela amaza, ukuhamba nge-paddle, noma ukubhukuda.
Abacwaningi babuze ngokuthi kulula kangakanani ukusebenzisa isevisi yokubikezela isimo sezulu esikhethiwe, nokuthi ukubikezela kwayo kwakuqondile futhi kuqondile kangakanani.
Ababambiqhaza babalule izici ezenze kwaba usizo futhi kubaluleke kakhulu kubo, baphinda bathi ingabe lezi zici zingase zishintshe ngenxa yoshintsho lwesimo sezulu.
Kwakudingeka futhi bathi noma bayethemba yini ulwazi olunikezwe izinsizakalo zezulu zasezweni labo, nokuthi bazizwa kanjani ngalo.
Iningi labantu baseNingizimu Afrika ababehileleke ocwaningweni babengabagibeli bezeqe, noma abantu abasiza emisebenzini yokusesha nokukhulula noma eziprojekthini zocwaningo.
Abantu abaningi baseNew Zealand abaphendule imibuzo babebuka izibikezelo zesimo sezulu ngoba babefuna ukuya ukudoba, ukuqhuba isikebhe noma ukuhamba ngomkhumbi olwandle.
Ababambiqhaza belizwe zombili babemethemba ulwazi abalunikwe yizikhonzi zezulu zamazwe abo.
Babethanda izinsizakalo zokubikezela ezinembile, ezihlala zifanayo, ezilula ukuzisebenzisa futhi ezinemikhakha engaguqulwa ukuze zifanele izidingo zabo.
Ababambi-qhaza abasebenzise le nsizakalo ngenhloso yemisebenzi ngokuvamile bathole ukuthi izibikezelo zezimo zasemanzini olwandle eduze komkhumbi zazingewona ukunemba okwanele.
Ulwazi lweminye imingcele lwalunembile kunolunye.
AbaseNingizimu Afrika babethanda ukusebenzisa izinsizakalo zezulu kakhulu kunabaseNew Zealand, futhi babebuka okungenani kanye ngosuku.
Kubaphenduli abayi-9 kwabayi-10, uhlelo oluhle kakhulu lokubikezela lwalubaluleke kakhulu.
Abaningi bakhetha isevisi eyayinika ukubuka kusukela ezinsukwini ezintathu kuya kwezingu-7 ezizayo.
Abantu abasebenza ekuhlinzeni kwezinto eziphilayo emanzini noma ababefanele bahlele ngezimo ezingase zenzeke ngokuzumayo babefuna ukuqagela kwesikhathi eside nokwezinkathi.

Abasebenzisi abaningi bakholelwa ukuthi ngenxa yokwanda kokushintsha kwesimo sezulu, izinsizakalo zokubikezela kuzofanele zisebenzise ulwazi olusekelwe esayensi oluhle nakakhulu esikhathini esizayo ukuze ziqinisekise ukunemba kokubikezela.
Ucwaningo olunje olungaka alukwenziwe ngaphambili emazweni aseHemisphere yaseNingizimu.
Abacwaningi bathemba ukuthi bakwazile ukufunda okwanele kubantu ababengabambene ngokuya ngemibuzo abababuze yona.
Omunye ubuthakathaka obunokwenzeka yikuthi abantu abaningi abahlala eNew Zealand kunaseNingizimu Afrika babeqobelele kulokhu kuphenyo.
Umsebenzi wabo uzosisiza abantu abasebenza ezinsizakalweni zokubikezela isimo sezulu ukuklama imikhiqizo engcono ethatha izidingo zeklayenti zabo.
Bayokwazi ukwenza uthuthuko kanye nezinguquko ngokuya ngokwaneliseka kwamakhasimende abo nokuthi kungani bewasebenzisa.
Indlela Yokubamba Iqhaza Ekulinganiseni Ukuqonda Kwezimo Ezikhona Zokushintsha Kwesimo Sezulu Kwemisebenzi Yokulima:
Icala laseLushoto
Umbono wezolimo oluhlakaniphile ngesimo sezulu (CSA) uyaqina emhlabeni wonke.
Kodwa-ke, aliqondile ngalokho okufanele kuhlanganiswe phansi kwezinsika zalo ezintathu—ukukhiqiza, ukuzinza nokunciphisa.
Ngenxa yalokho, i-CSA ihlanganisa izindlela/izinkambiso zezolimo eziningi ezahlukene, okwenza kube nzima ukukhetha imigomo ye-CSA.
Okokuqala, kunokungabikho kokulinganisela okuqondile nokusebenza kahle kanye nezindlela zokuhlola ubuhle bezinhlelo zokusebenza eziqaphela isimo sezulu.
Okwesibili, ulwazi oluncane lukhona mayelana nethonya lezinqubo ezihlukahlukene eziveliwe njenge-CSA, ikakhulukazi ezweni elithuthukayo.
Ekugcineni, ukwenza phambili kwe-CSA akuthathi izingqondo zabantu abathintekayo ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenza zisebenza, zifanele futhi zinekhono elikhulu lokwamukelwa.
Lapha, sichaza uhlelo oluhlanganyele olulodwa lokulinganisa ubuhlakani bezezimboni zezolimo ezikhuthaza ukumelana nokushintsha kwesimo sezulu emikwenzeni yabathengisi abancinyane.
Lokhu kuqopha izibonakaliso (nezinqamula) zezinga lefama zezinsika zezokuphepha kokudla nokuguqukela kwe-CSA.
Iphinde futhi isekela ukulinganisa okuhlanganyelwe kwezimpawu, okwenza kube nokwenzeka ukwenza ukuhlolwa okuqala nokukwaziswa kwesikhathi esizayo sokuqonda kahle isimo sezulu.
Le phurothokholi livivinywe phakathi kwabalima abangu-72 abasebenzisa izinhlobo ezihlukahlukene zezinqubo ze-CSA eLushoto, eTanzania, elisesigodini esihlakaniphile ngokwemozulu.

Abalimi ngokukhethekile babeqakathekisa izinhlelo ezaziphumelela ekulungiseni ukutheleleka komhlabathi nesakhiwo sawo, ezinciphise ukugeleza kwamanzi ephusheni, futhi ezibuyisela izindawo ezonakele ngenxa yemiphumela emihle ekukhuleni komkhiwane nokulima izilimo ezingekho ephasini.
Ngokuyinhloko, izinhlelo zokusebenta ze-CSA zandise ukukhiqizwa kwezilwane, ukukhiqizwa kokudla, ukusetshenziswa kanye nomholo.
Leli phrotokoli kulula ukulilungisa ngokwezindawo ezahlukene nezinhlelo zokulima futhi liyavumela ukuba kube khona ukunikezwa okungcono kokuqala kwemisebenzi yokwelapha.
Kodwa-ke, sincoma ukuthi i-CSA yamukelwe njengengxenye yendlela yokubeka amehlo, ukuhlola nokufunda.
Izindlela ezintsha zokubeka iliso zisiza ososayensi nabalimi ukuba balungiselele ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu.
Oososayensi abasebenza nabalimi eTanzania manje bangalinganisa ukuthi izindlela ezintsha zokulima zisebenza kangakanani ekuqedeni imiphumela yoshintsho lwesimo sezulu.
Bathemba ukuthi indlela yabo izokuthuthukisa ukuphepha kokudla kanye nemikhiqizo yemikhakha yabalimai ezingxenyeni zezwe.
“Ukukulima okuhlakaniphile ngesimo sezulu” kuyinto uHulumeni wamalungisi ayikhuthaza ukusiza abalimi abancinyane ukuba balungiselele ushintsho lwesimo sezulu.
Umgcini wezitshalo oqondayo isimo sezulu uzilungisa ngokushintsha kwesimo sezulu futhi uyakwazi ukwandisa ukuphepha kokudla ngokuthuthukisa ukukhiqizwa kwezitshalo zakhe.
Lena yinkinga ebaluleke kakhulu kubalimi baseTanzania, njengoba izwe selihlushwa yisivuno esincane semikhiqizo ebalulekile yokudla okunjengomgwaqo ngenxa yoshintsho lwemozulu.

Kodwa-ke, abacwaningi bathi kunzima ukulinganisa impumelelo yezinhlelo zokusebenza eziqaphela isimo sezulu, njengokwenza umanyolo, futhi abalimi ngokwabo ababuzwa njalo ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenza zisebenza ngendlela ebiqondiswe ngayo.

Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi bafuna ukuklama indlela yokulinganisa impumelelo yezinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlakaniphile ngesimo sezulu, ngokugxila ngokukhethekile ekulungiseni ukuphepha kokudla nokuqondana.
Ukuqala, bafunde ezinye izifundo zezolimo baze benze uhlu olu-2 oluhlanganisa izici eziyi-14, noma “izibonakaliso”, ezibalulekile ekuqondeni ukuphepha kokudla nokuguqulwa.
Bese, bebenza eLushoto District eTanzania, abacwaningi basebenzisana nabalimi bendawo kanye nochwepheshe abaningi bezemilimi ukuze baqonde izibonakaliso ezibaluleke kakhulu kuwo wonke uhlu.
Abalimi baqaphele ukukhiqizwa kokudla njengophawu oluqakathekile kakhulu lokuqinisekisa ukuphepha kokudla.
Ngamanye amazwi, noma iyiphi imisebenzi eyenze ukukhula kwezitshalo zabo kwaba ngcono yayibaluleke kakhulu.

Okwamanje, ngokuqondene nokuqondana, abalimi babethakazelisa ngokukhethekile izinhlelo ezazibasiza ukuthi bavikele umhlabathi wezimahla zezolimo zabo, kanye nalezo ezithuthukisile ulwazi, amakhono, kanye nomholo wabo.
Ngemva kokuba abacwaningi sebeqinisekisile ukubaluleka kwesibonisi ngasinye, bakwazi ukulisebenzisa ukuhlola ukuphumelela kwezinhlobo eziyisithupha zokungenelela eLushoto.
Kuzo zonke izimo, babebuza abalimi bendawo, ngesikali esingu-1-5, ukuthi ngabe kwakukhona ukwanda kwesibonakaliso ngasinye kusukela lapho kuqalwa khona ukungenelela.
Lokhu kwenze kwaba nokwenzeka ukubona ukuthi yiziphi izixazululo ezazinomphumela omkhulu ekuphepheni kokudla nokuziqondanisa.
Bathole kuphela ukungenelela okungu-3 kwezingu-6 ezazisetshenziswa kwakunothinta olukhulu.
Lezo zazingamakhukhunthi okuhlanganisa, izinhlobo zezitshalo ezingamelana nendlala, futhi zinikeza ukudla okungcono kwezilwane.

Abacwaningi bathi indlela yabo yenza kube lula ukuqinisekisa ukuthi izinhlelo zokungenelela zesikhathi esizayo zihlangabezana nezidingo zabalimi baseLushoto kanye nemigomo yokuhlinza kwezolimo oluhlakaniphile.

Bengeza ukuthi ukukhetha izindlela zokungenelela ezifanele kuphinde kukhulise amathuba okuba abalimi bancoma amasiko amahle kubamelene babo, ngaleyo ndlela basakaza imibono ehlakaniphile ngesimo sezulu.

Ngokuyisisekelo, le ndlela ingasetshenziswa nakwezinye izindawo, futhi ingasiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi amasu ahlakaniphile ezingqondweni zezimo eziguqukayo ezemvelo abheka izimo zasekhaya nolwazi lolwimi lwabalima ngokubeka iliso nokuhlola okuqhubekayo.
Ngokuyenza kanjalo, izinhlelo zokulima eziqaphela ukuwohloka kwesimo sezulu zinezindlela eziningi zokuphumelela futhi zithole ukwamukelwa, kokubili eTanzania nakwamanye amazwe ase-Afrika.
Ucwaningo lwaluyisivumelwano sokusebenzisana phakathi kwesayensi zaseKenya naseNetherlands.
Izimbangi Zezilwane Ezinamagxathu Njengezinhlobo Ezifakwe: Ukuqonda Okuvela eNingizimu Afrika
Ukutadisha izilwanyana ezibangela izifo njengezinhlobo zasemzini ezihlaselayo akutholanga ukunakekelwa okukhulu ensimini yesayensi yokuhlasela.
Izifo ezitholakale zingaba nemiphumela emikhulu ezintweni eziphilayo, ezinhlelweni zezinto eziphilayo ezihlala kuzo, nasezimweni zezomnotho ezisekelwa yilezo zinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo.

Kulesi sahluko, sisebenzisa izifundo zezimo zezifo ezithunyelwe ezilwaneni zasekhaya nezasendle (ukuthukuthela kwezinja, isifo sofuba sezinkomo, ne-rinderpest) nabantu (isihlangu, isifo sofuba, ne-human immunodeficiency virus, i-HIV) ukuze kubonakaliswe izinhlobo zemiphumela lezi zifo ezingayibangela.

Uthonyo olukhulu kunazo zonke oluye lwabonakala kuze kube manje luye lwaba lukarinderpest, oluholele ekufeni kwezinkomo ezigidigidi, futhi lwabhubhisa cishe izinhlobo ezithile zezilwane zasendle ezingxenyeni ezinkulu zaseNingizimu Afrika.
Lokhu kube nomthelela omkhulu kwesikhathi esifushane emnothweni wesifunda, futhi kwabangela ukuguquka okukhulu kwesakhiwo kanye nokusebenza kwezinhlelo zezinto eziphilayo.
I-Rinderpest iqedwe emhlabeni wonke, kodwa bobabili i-rabies yezinja ne-tuberculosis yezilwane zasendlini basaphila, futhi kuzodingeka ukulinda nokulawula okuqhubekayo ukuze kuboshwe.
Ezifweni zabantu, isifo samathambo naso siqothulwe emhlabeni jikelele, kodwa umphumela wesifo, esafakwa abakoloni baseYurophu, wawubhubhisayo.

Ekuqaleni kweminyaka yo-1700, ingxenye enkulu (fingqa ku-90% kwamanye amabandla) yabantu bakwaKhoekhoe abangabantu bomdabu yafa, yabhubhisa amasiko abo kanye nendlela yabo yokuphila, yashiya abasindile abambalwa ukuthi baqashwe njengabasebenzi befama.
I-HIV, eyatholakala okokuqala eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1982, iye yaba nemiphumela emikhulu futhi ukwelashwa nge-antiretroviral kudla uhulumeni u-ZAR 66.4 billion ngonyaka.
Sihlanganisa ne-West Nile Virus ne-African Swine Fever njengezibonelo zezifo eziqale e-Afrika, futhi ezingase zibe yingozi emhlabeni jikelele.
Sibikezela ukuthi izifo ezintsha ziyophumela njengoba abantu beqhubeka banweba indawo yabo ezindaweni zasendle, futhi njengoba ubuningi bokuhweba bukhula.
Okwaziwa ngabacwaningi ngabaphangi abancinyane ababangela izifo eNingizimu Afrika

Isahluko sale ncwadi sihlanganisa ulwazi lwamuva ngezifo ezinjengesihlangu, isifo sezilwane esibulalayo, isifo sofuba, ne-HIV, zonke ezihambisana nemikrofoni ehlala ehlala (amavithamini, amabhaktheriya nezinye izidalwa ezincane ezibhekwa njengesizukulwane esingaphandle, okusho ukuthi azitholakali ngokwemvelo endaweni ethile).
Lezi zifo zonke zithinta izilwane nabantu eNingizimu Afrika, futhi ukuqhuma kwazo ekugcineni kulimaza umnotho wezwe.

Enkundleni yocwaningo ebizwa ngokuthi ‘isayensi yokuhlasela’, ososayensi bafunda izilwanyana ezikhula futhi zibangele umonakalo ngemuva kokungeniswa ezindaweni ezintsha lapho zingatholakali khona ngokujwayelekile.
Ucwaningo oluningi luye lwogxila ezinhlotsheni ezinkulu "ezifakayo" njengezitshalo nezilwane, kodwa abahlaseli abanemikrofoni ababangela izifo balingana ngokubaluleka.
Kulesi sahluko, ababhali baxoxe ngezinye izifo zezilwane nabantu eNingizimu Afrika ezihambisana nalabo omahluleli abangeniswe.
Bathe bathi esibi kunazo zonke kwakuwukugula kwe ‘rinderpest’, okwatholakala eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1896.
Isifo se-Rinderpest sasiyisifo esibangelwa yi-virus futhi sasihlasela izinkomo neenqama.
Umsundu ofanayo owabangela i-measles kubantu.
Abantu abaningi basemakhaya bahlushwa yindlala ngemva kokubhebhetheka kuka-1896, kodwa manje isifo sisusiwe ngokugonywa.
Ababhali bathi phakathi kuka-1772 no-1861, izinja eziningi eNingizimu Afrika zazinobhubhane, yize abantu babengalwazi ukuthi iyiphi leyo gciwane.
Ngo-1893, kwakwaziwa ukuthi i-rabies yayibangelwa yi-virus, ngakho-ke uhulumeni wanquma ukubulala izinja ezazihlazwe futhi abayekezele abangazange bahlazwe.
Nokho, lokhu akuzange kuqede lesi sifo, futhi sasathinta izilwane eziningi zasendle njenge-duikers, izimpisi, izinja zasendle, ama-jackal nama-foxes.
Ababhali bathi ngo-1928, abantwana ababili bakhonjwa yi-Yellow Mongoose bafa ngenxa ye-rabies.
Kusukela ngaleso sikhathi, ubuhlanya baba lukhulu eNingizimu Afrika.
Bathe bathi ngo-1954, abantu abaningi baseNingizimu Afrika nabo bathinteka yisifo sikamabule.
Lapho le sahluko sibhalwa, isifo sofuba sasibulawa abantwana abangaba ngu-400 nsuku zonke.
Bathe bakhuluma ukuthi isifo sikamasela besivame lapho abantu nemfuyo bekude bodwa.
Ababhali bakhulume futhi ngesifo esibizwa ngokuthi i-bovine tuberculosis (BTB), esibangelwa yibhaktheriya.
I-BTB yabulala izinkomo, izinyathi, izinqindi, izimpisi, ama-leopard, ama-kudu, ama-baboon kanye nezingonyama.
Bathi isifo se-BTB sabikwa okokuqala ephaki likazwelonke laseNingizimu Afrika ngo-1996.
Uhulumeni walwela lesifo ngokubulala izinkabi ezibe nezifo.
Ababhali bathi omunye umkhuhlane, owayeziswe eNingizimu Afrika ngabagibeli abavela eYurophu, wabangela isifo esibizwa ngokuthi ‘isihlangu’ kubantu.
Lesi sifo sibulale abantu abangaphezu kuka-90% beKhoekhoe bendawo.
Ekupheleni kokuphahlazeka kwesifo, isiko lamaKhoekhoe sase siqothulwe cishe ngokuphelele.
Ababhali babike futhi nge-human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) eyabangela ukuphahlazeka kwesifo se-AIDS.
Oososayensi basacabanga ukuthi i-virus yaqale yadluliselwa kubantu evela ezilwaneni, ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-zoonosis.
Ukuqhuma komkhuhlane kuqale kwabonakala eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1982.
Bathe bathi, kusukela ngo-2019, i-HIV yayingenayo imithi yokuvikela noma yokwelapha.
Baqede isahluko ngokukhuluma nge-West Nile Virus ne-African Swine Fever, abathi iqale e-Afrika yase isakazeka eYurophu naseMelika.
I-West Nile virus idluliselwe yizinyosi futhi yabulala ikakhulukazi izinyoni, kodwa futhi yathinta amahhashi nabantu.
Bathe bathi izilwane ezifana nezingulube zasehlathini nezinkomo zasehlathini zithumelela isifo se-African swine fever.
Ubuthi buthinte izinkukhu, futhi buthinte kakhulu ibhizinisi lezingulube.
Ababhali bathi baxoxe kuphela ngezifo ezibangelwa yibhaktheriya nezinambuzane, ngakho-ke le sahluko akuyona ingxelo ephelele yazo zonke izilwanyana ezincinci ezifakelayo.
Ababhali babevela eNingizimu Afrika.
Uhlelo lokusebenza lokuhlinzwa olusekela ebufakazini lokuphatha i-Odontogenic keratocyst
Ukuphathwa okuphumelelayo kwe-odontogenic keratocyst (OKC) kuhlala kuyisihloko esithakazelisayo nesiphazamisayo kuzincwadi zobukwazi bokuhlinzwa komlomo nobuso.
Okwamanje, ayikho indlela efanayo yokwelapha abantu abanesifo se-odontogenic keratocyst.
Kuzo zonke izinketho zokwelapha ezitholakalayo, akukho luhlobo oluye lwabonisa amazinga okubuyela kabusha angama-zero noma aseduze ne-zero ngaphandle kokusika okubanzi ngemikhawulo ecacile.

Ngenxa yokushoda kwemibhalo ephakamileyo yesayensi emayelana nezindlela zokwelapha eziqondene nokwelashwa kwabaguli abane-odontogenic keratocyst, ucwaningo olukhona luhlosile ukwethula uhlelo lokusebenza lokuhlinzwa, olusekwe emiphumeleni ye-meta-analysis, elithemba ukuthi luzoba usizo ekwenzeni kube ngcono ukwelashwa kwabaguli abanesimo.

Sisebenzisa izilinganiso ze;usayizi, uhlobo lwesilonda (esiyinhloko noma esesibili), ubukhulu besilonda (esinobunzima noma esiyedwa), ukuba khona kweziqu eziqhekekile, kanye nokuhlukaniswa; sibonisa umuthi wokunquma, ukusiza ekuhleleni ukwelashwa futhi kusize ukuthola amathuba amancane okuphinda kuvela ekuphatheni i-odontogenic keratocyst.
Abacwaningi baphinde baphakamise izindlela zokwelapha kangcono isifo somlomo.

Ngokuhlanganisa imiphumela yophenyo olukhona, abacwaningi baqamba izinyathelo ezicacile abagqirha abangazilandela ukuze bahlonze futhi baphathe iziguli ezine-sickness yomhlathi ebizwa nge-‘odontogenic karatocyst’ (OKC).
I-OKC iwumkhuhlane, noma ukukhula okungavamile, emaxatheni omuntu.
Odokotela bayithola le simo ibunzima ukuyiphatha, futhi iziguli zivame ukuthola enye i-OKC ngisho nangemva kokwelashwa okuphumelelayo.
Ngakho-ke, odokotela bafuna izindlela zokwelapha ngokuphumelelayo nangokuphelele lezi zilonda emagundwini.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi bafuna izinyathelo eziyisisekelo odokotela okufanele bazithathe ukuze bahlonze futhi baphathe lesi sifo.
Bakwenze lokhu ngokucinga ezincwadini ezikhona, noma ezinhlobonhlobo zesayensi, eziphathelene ne-OKC.
Babecinga ngokuqondile ulwazi mayelana nendlela odokotela abaphatha ngayo i-OKC phakathi nonyaka, njengoba kubikwe ezihlokweni ezingu-46 abazitholile.
Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi i-OKC yayivame kakhulu kumadoda kunabesifazane, futhi ingathinta abantu abaneminyaka efinyelela ku-90, ngisho noma yayivame phakathi kweminyaka engu-20 no-30.
Ubuhlungu buye babathinta kakhulu amaxhafu angaphansi.
I-OKC iqala ngaphakathi kwempumputhe, nokukhula komlomo kubonakala kamuva kuphela.
Abantu abagulayo bavame ukuzwa ubuhlungu futhi babe nokuqothuka okuthile (isigaxa, njengopusu, oluphuma ehlombe noma ebuhlungwini), futhi imizuzu yamazinyo abo ingase iphume endaweni.
Baphinde basekele ukuthi odokotela basuse yonke inxeba namazinyo aseduze.

Uma sekuqediwe ukususa, kufanele basebenzise imithi ebizwa ngokuthi yi-Carnoy’s solution, kanye ne-nitrogen eyi-liquid (ilwetshe eliqandayo kakhulu elisetshenziswa ekususeni ngokushesha isikhumba esonakele) ne-fluorouracil (eyaziwa nangokuthi yi-5FU, imithi evamile yomdlavuza).
Ngemva kwalolu phiko, abacwaningi bancoma ukuthi umuntu ophethwe kufanele abe nezivivinyo zempilo zokulandelela iminyaka engaphansi kuka-25.
Bathe bathi leli phiko lilungele kakhulu izilonda ezincane kunesithelo se-strawberry (3 cm).
Kubalulekile ukunaka kakhulu izilonda ezingaphezu kuka-3 cm.
Bathe bathi odokotela kufanele baqale banciphise ukucindezeleka ngaphakathi kwesilonda bese bakhipha ulwelo, futhi bakhiphe wonke amatishu asezungeze umgubhu.
Kumelwe kube sekuphathwa ngesixazululo sikaCarnoy.
Bacebisa ukuthi odokotela kufanele bahlole laba ziguli njalo ngenyanga ezimbili iminyaka emibili.
Uma umguli enezinhlungu eziningi, odokotela bangazikhipha ngezinye izinto zezibhedlela ezikhethekile.
Kodwa ngokujwayelekile, izifundo ezibuyekezwe zikhombisile ukuthi ezimweni eziningi, uma odokotela besusa isifo bese befake i-5FU, iziguli azizukubuye zithole i-OKC.
Kodwa-ke, baxwayisa ukuthi ubufakazi balezi zindlela zokwelapha babungelona oluqinile njalo, futhi bathola izincwadi zesayensi ezimbalwa ngale ndaba.
Abacwaningi abazange benze namaciko abo ukuze banikeze lezi zincomo; kunalokho, bazama ukuqoqa izindlela zokwelapha ezaziwa kakhulu ezivela eziphindweni ezenziwe abacwaningi abanye.
Ngakho-ke, labo bacwaningi, abahlala eNigeria nase-USA, bancoma ukuthi kwenziwe ucwaningo olwengeziwe emazweni ahlukene ukuze kuvivinywe impumelelo yemithi ephakanyisiwe lapha.
Baphinda bakhuthaza odokotela ukuba bacabangele ezinye izimo zabaguli ngesikhathi sokwelapha.
Isifo se-SARS-CoV-2 (2019-nCoV), i-MERS-CoV ne-SARSr-CoV esenziwe ngokwenziwa: Ukuhlaziywa komshini okuqhathaniswayo ukuze kunikezwe iziphakamiso ze-epitopes.

Ama-coronavirus avame ukuba ngokuqondile kwesilwane esithile njengomphathi, izilwane ezincelisayo noma izinyoni kuye ngohlobo lwazo; noma kunjalo, le mi-virus ingashintsha umphathi ngezinye izikhathi ngenxa yokuguqulwa.
I-HCoV-229E ingenye yemi-coronaviruses emihlanu yabantu ehlanganisa i-HCoV-NL63, i-HCoV-OC43, i-HCoV-HKU1, i-MERS-CoV ne-SARSr-CoV (i-SARSr-CoV-1 ne-SARS-CoV2) futhi isabalale emhlabeni wonke.
I-MERS-CoV ne-SARS-CoV-2 zingaphila ezintweni ezingaphili njenge (ensimbi, igalasi noma ipulasitiki kuze kube izinsuku ezingu-9) (Huang, C.-L, 2020).
Izinyathelo zokuvimbela kanye nokuphathwa kwemithi nge-hydrochloroquine kuyasiza, kodwa kungenzeka ukuthi kudingeka isifo sokuvikela esisebenza kahle ukuze kuvinjelwe ukwanda komkhuhlane we-covid-19.
Inhloso yocwaningo lwethu kwakuwukubona ama-epitope okuyizidakamizwa ngezindlela ze-bioinformatics.
Izinto Nezindlela

Izinhlelo ezigcwele ze-genome ze-SARS-CoV-2 zithathwe ku-2019 Novel Coronavirus Resource (2019nCoVR) nasezinkundleni zedatha ezimbili, okuhlanganisa i-National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) Global Initiative on Sharing All Influenza Data (GISAID) ne-TAURAU/T-bio-infoserver ye-bioinformatics eku-inthanethi.

Sizokunikeza isifinyeto esifushane sokuvela kwe-viral, siqhathanise idatha yokulandelana ukuze siqonde indawo ehlala iphelele, i-domain yayo yeprotheni evame kakhulu (indawo yokubopha umgomo) kanye nokuklama i-motif evumelanayo yomkhiqizo we-molecule onamandla (epitope) oqaphelwe ngenhloso yokuqamba amasu okwelapha i-2019-nCoV, i-SARSr-CoV strain ne-MERS-CoV ezitholakele okusha.
Kuyathakazelisa ukuthi, ukulinganiswa kolwemi phakathi kwe-SARS-CoV-2 nezinye izinhlobo kwembula ukuthi izinsalela ezikhona ku-receptor-interacting motive zigcinwe kakhulu ngokufana okungu-70%.
Sisekele ama-amino acid abalulekile amahlanu (L455, Y473, N479, F486, Q493) esizindeni sokubopha i-receptor evela kumaphrotheni e-spike abhekene nokuthintana phakathi kwe-virus ne-horst.
Ku-SARS-CoV-2 RBD kukhona izinsalela (D480, ne-T487) ezavumela ukutheleleka phakathi kwezinhlobo.
Kodwa-ke, ku-SARS-CoV-2, ukuguqulwa okuncane kweminye imfucuza kungathuthukisa ukusebenzelana nomukhahleli weselula yomuntu: L455, F486, Q493, ne-N501.
Ku-SARS-CoV, izinsalela ezimbili eziyinhloko (479 no-487) ziye zahlanganiswa nokubona komukeli we-ACE2 wabantu.
Ku-SARS-CoV-2, izinsalela ezifanele ku-N479 zifanele ku-Q493 ne-T487 ku-N501.

Sikwazi ukubona uchungechunge lwamangqamuzana e-amino acid aqinile kakhulu kuma-coronavirus amaningi kuhlanganise ne-2019nCoV nezinye izinhlobo, i-motif i-KRSFIEDLLFNKVTLADAGF itholakele ikhulu ukuba iqinile kule ncwadi futhi ihambisana nendawo ezungezile kwenye yezindawo ezibonakalayo zokusika ze-SARS virus okubekwe ukuba kuyadingeka ukuvuselela i-virus ukuze kungene eselini.

Le motif yeqhaza kanye nezinguquko ezizungezile zakha isisekelo sokusikisela i-epitope yeqhaza lokugonywa elenziwe ngokukhethekile; lo mtholampilo ungenza abakhethi abancane be-molecule abanamandla futhi ababopheka.
Ucwaningo lolu lunikeza ulwazi nethuba lokufakazelwa kwendalo.
Lokhu kusebenza kungachazwa ngamagama e-bioinformatics, futhi kuphindwe kalula abanye, yize idatha entsha nocwaningo lwe-Covid-19 luvela futhi luqhubeka ngesivinini esikhulu.
Izifundiswa ziqhathanisa i-Covid-19 nezinye izifo ezifana nayo ukuze zisize ekufuneni ama-vaccine.
