Ngo-Septemba 2020, ososayensi baseMali baqhathanisa ulwazi oluvela e-genetic lwe-Covid-19 virus nezinye izinhlobo ze-coronaviruses ezifana kakhulu ukuze baqonde izici ezingasiza ekuthuthukiseni i-vaccine.
Ngaleso sikhathi, ososayensi babebusafuna izigqoko zokuvimbela i-Covid-19 eziphumelelayo.
Babefisa ukubona ukuguqulwa kwe-Covid-19 virus okungase kudlale indima ekuthelelekeni.
Ngakho-ke, abacwaningi baseMali baqhathanise i-virus ye-Covid-19 (SARS-CoV-2) nezinye izinhlobo ze-coronavirus ezibangela izifo kubantu, okuyi-MERS-CoV ne-SARS-CoV.
Enye yezinjongo eziyinhloko zocwaningo kwakuwukuthola izindawo ezithile e-Covid-19 virus, ebizwa ngokuthi yi-epitopes, ezingabonwa yi-immune system yabantu.
Ukubachaza kungabasiza ososayensi ukuba benze izigaxa eziphumelelayo kakhulu.
Abacwaningi baphinda bafanisa ama-virus amathathu ukuze babone ukuthi kukhona yini ukufana kwe-genetic okungasiza ekuthuthukiseni imithi yokuvikela.
Bagxile kwinhlanganisela ye-genetic yephrotheni ye-spike yama-virus, ezingamaphrotheni abhekene nokusiza ama-coronavirus ukubopha, nokutheleleka, amaseli abantu.
Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi amaprotheni e-spike awama-virus onke amathathu ayefana kakhulu ngokufana, ikakhulukazi izingxenye ezihlangana namasendlini abantu.
Okwakhazimulayo nge-Covid-19 iwukuthi kwakukhona ukuguquka okuncane kwe-spike protein okwakwenza i-virus ikwazi ukubopha kahle ezintweni zabantu.

Imiphumela yalesi sifundo ingase ivumele abanye abacwaningi ukuthi bathuthukise izibulala-magciwane ze-Covid-19 eziphumelela kakhulu ngokubasiza ukuthi baqonde izindawo ezinobhubhane eziyizinhloso ezinhle zezibulala-magciwane.
Ucwaningo luphinde lwabonelela ngolwazi olusha mayelana nokuthandana nokungafani kwezakhiwo ze-genetic phakathi kwe-Covid-19 nezinye izinhlobo ze-coronavirus.

Abacwaningi baphawule ukuthi ucwaningo lwesikhathi esizayo kufanele lugxile ekutheni ingabe ukwahluka kwezakhiwo ze-genetic ku-Covid-19 virus kuyenza ibe nomthelela omkhulu futhi iyingozi kunezinye izinhlobo ze-coronavirus.
Ukuphazanyiswa Kwezinhliziyo Kubantu AbabeNe-COVID-19: Ukuhlaziywa Okusetshenziswayo Nokuhlaziywa KweMeta-analysis
Ukuphazamiseka kokushaya kwenhliziyo akunakwenqatshelwa kubantu abane-coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) njengoba kunomthelela omkhulu emiphumeleni.
Ngakho-ke, le ncwadi ihlose ukwakha ubufakazi obuqinile mayelana nokwanda kwe-cardiac arrhythmia kubantu abane-COVID-19.
Senze ukucinga okucacile kwamadathabase/izinjini zokucinga ezinokwethenjwa okuhlanganisa i-PubMed, i-Scopus, i-Cochrane library ne-web of science.
Ngemva kokuhlola, idatha efanele ikhishiwe futhi izingozi ezivela eziphindweni ezihlanganisiwe zihlanganiswe ukuze kwenziwe i-meta-analysis.
Ekugcineni, ucwaningo oluyisishiyagalolunye lufake kulokhu esikwenzayo, oluqukethe iziguli ezingama-1445.
Imiphumela yokuhlaziya okuhlanganisiwe ibonise ukuthi ukwanda kwesifo se-arrhythmia kubantu abane-COVID-19 kwakuwu-19.7% nge-95% confidence interval (CI) ephakathi kuka-11.7 no-27.6%.
Kwakuphinde kube khona ukungafani okukhulu (I2□=□94.67%).
Ukungazinzi kwenhliziyo kwakukhulu kakhulu kubantu abane-COVID-19 futhi kubonwe ku-19.7% kubo.
Ukubhekwa okuqondile nge-electrocardiogram, kanye nokuqaphela okuchane kanye nokusheshayo kwe-arrhythmias kubalulekile ekuphatheni nasemiphumeleni emihle.
Abantu abaningi abane-Covid-19 babe nesikhathi esingavamile sokubetha kwenhliziyo.
Abacwaningi bathi cishe omunye kubantu abangu-5 abane-Covid-19 uhlangabezana ne-cardiac arrhythmia, eyaziwa nangokuthi ukushaya kwenhliziyo okungajwayelekile.

Ngenxa yokuthi kuyinto evamile kangaka, bayeka ukuqapha izinga lokuphakama kwenhliziyo yomguli besebenzisa umshini obizwa ngokuthi yi-electrocardiogram, ukuze odokotela bakwazi ukuhlonza futhi baphathe noma yikuphi ukungalingani kwesikhathi sokuphakama kwenhliziyo ngokushesha okukhulu.
Nakuba i-Covid-19 ithonya amaphaphu nezinhlangothi zokuphefumula kakhulu, ucwaningo oluthile lubonise ukuthi ingathinta nenhliziyo.

Abacwaningi babefuna ukuhlola idatha yabagula ukuze babone ukuthi izinkinga zokushona kwenhliziyo zazivame kangakanani ngempela kubantu ababe ne-Covid-19 ngo-2020, ekuqaleni kwegciwane lomhlaba jikelele.

Benze ukuhlaziywa okuhlanganisiwe, okuwukuthi abacwaningi bahlaziya izifundo eziningi ezahlukene ngesihloko esithile ukuzama ukuthola iziphetho eziyinhloko ezivela kuzo zonke izifundo ezihlanganisiwe.

Bafuna izifundo ezihlolwe ngabanye abacwaningi ezisebenzisana nezinye izisekelo zolwazi, baphuma nganoma yiluphi ulwazi olufanele mayelana nokushaya kwenhliziyo okungajwayelekile kubantu abane-Covid-19.
Ekugcineni, bafake izifundo eziyi-9 ezinolwazi mayelana nabaguli abangu-1445.
Bathole ukuthi i-arrhythmias yentliziyo ibonwe ku-19.7% yabagula be-Covid-19.
Nokho, bayaxwayisa ukuthi inani elincane lezincwadi abazisebenzisile lingase lilimaze isiphetho sabo.
Ezinye zezifundo azizange zichaze uhlobo oluqondile lwenkinga yentliziyo, futhi ukulinganiselwa kwesifundo ngasinye kungadida ukulinganiselwa kokuhlaziywa kwazo okuhlanganisiwe.
Baphinde baphakamise ukubheka kusasa ukuthi kungani iziguli eziningi ezine-Covid-19 zazinamazinga ezingqondo engaqondakali.
Ababhali bale ncwadi bevela eGibhithe, kodwa iziguli kule ncwadi bevela eChina nase-USA.
Iimbono Zezazi Zokwelapha Ezinye Ngokuthuthela Kwezwe, Impilo Yengqondo Ne-PTSD:
Ubuyekezo Bolwazi Olufanele
Kulesi sahluko, sinikezela ngokubuyekezwa kwezifundo zokulinga ezaqhutshwa ngo-PTSD, impilo yengqondo nokuzwela kwabafuduki.

Ucwaningo oluningi lubonisa ukuthi kokubili abacindezelayo abaphambi nokuhamba kwabantu kanye nababekhona ngemuva kokufudukela kwabantu bayathinta impilo yengqondo kanye ne-PTSD yabafuduki nabaphambukeli.
Emazweni okuqala, ukuvezwa ezingozini kanye nokuhlukunyezwa kwakubangela ingozi enkulu empilweni yengqondo yabafuduki.

Izinkinga zempilo yengqondo ezibangela usizi olukhulu kubafuduki emazweni abamukelayo zihlanganisa ukucindezeleka kokujwayela amasiko amasha, isimo somthetho, ukuhlukaniswa komndeni, isiphephelo lolwimi, ukufinyelela okubi kunakekelwa kwempilo efanele, ukucwaswa, ubuhlanga, imizwa yokungabi namandla, ukwehla kokuzithemba, usizi oluqhubekayo nokuqapha okukhulu.
Phakathi kwazo zonke izinkinga zempilo yengqondo, ukucindezeleka, ukukhathazeka ne-PTSD kubhekwa njengezivamile kakhulu ngeminani yokuvela engu-4–40%, 5–44% kanye no-9–36% ngokulandelana.
Ngokuvamile, ukwesekwa komphakathi nezindlela zokubhekana nezinkinga ezihlukahlukene kubonwe njengokunciphisa ingozi.
Impilo yengqondo yabaphambukeli ithonya isimo abasishiyile kanye nokuhlala endaweni entsha.
Abantu abathuthela kwamanye amazwe nababaleka bavame ukuhlupheka ngokuxineka okungapheli emva kokulimelela nezinye izinkinga zempilo yengqondo.
Nakuba izinkinga eziningi zibangelwa izinto ezenzeka emazweni abo, ososayensi bathi kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi ukucindezeleka kokuphila ezweni elisha kungakwengeza kule nkinga.
Ngokwocwaningo oluningi, ukucindezeleka, ukukhathazeka, kanye ne-post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) konke kuyizinkinga zempilo yengqondo ezivamile phakathi kwabantu abahamba ngezizwe nababaleki.
I-PTSD ngokuvamile iyimbangela yokusinda kwemicimbi eyingozi noma eyonakalisa, futhi abantu bavame ukuhlangabezana nemiphumela yalezo zenzakalo ezimbi izinyanga, noma ngisho neminyaka.
Kulesifundo, abacwaningi bafuna ukuqonda izici ezahlukene ezidlalayo indima ezinkingeni zempilo yengqondo yabantu abathuthela kwamanye amazwe njenge-PTSD.
Ngakho-ke, benze uhlobo lokufunda okuthiwa yi-review, lapho bahlanganisa khona ulwazi oluvela kwezinye izifundo eziningi ngale ndaba, ukuze bathole izindlela ezijwayelekile noma izingqikithi.
Ezimweni eziningi, izinkinga zempilo yengqondo zabafuduki zazibangelwa yizenzakalo ezibuhlungu njengempi, ukulahlekelwa abathandekayo, noma ubudlova bomzimba obuqale emazweni abo.
Lapho laba bantu bephuma kulezo zimo, bahlangabezana nezihambi ezinzima kodwa-ke bazizwa bekhululekile lapho befika ezweni elisha.
Abacwaningi, noma kunjalo, bathi lokuphumula kwakuyikwesikhashana, ngoba izifuduki zibhekene nezinselele ezintsha ngemuva kokuthuthela kwenye indawo.
Bathole ukuthi izifiki zivame ukuba nesikhathi esinzima ezweni elisha, ikakhulu uma zingalwazi ulimi, noma zinezinkinga zokujwayela amasiko.

Uma abantu befikile ezweni ngokungekho emthethweni, noma bezama ukuthola ukukhosela, kwakudingeka bahlangane nezinkinga zomthetho, futhi bavame ukuba nobunzima bokuthola izinsizakalo ezinjengokunakekelwa kwezempilo.
Kwabanye, ubandlululo nobuhlanga ezweni labo elisha kwenezela emizwelweni yabo yokungaphephileki, futhi abaningi bashiye amalungu omndeni ngemuva futhi babe bodwa.
Lezi zinto zinezandla ekubeni kube khona izinkinga zempilo yengqondo eziqhubekayo, ngisho nalapho laba bafuduki besesimweni esiphephile kunesikhathi besekhaya labo.

Abacwaningi benezela ukuthi izifiki zazinezindlela eziningi ezihlukene zokubhekana nalezi zinkinga, kusukela ekucwaningeni ngokucophelela ukuthi zingazixazulula kanjani, kuya ekufuneni usizo kwabanye emphakathini wazo, noma izindlela ezimbi kakhulu njengokusebenzisa izidakamizwa.
Abacwaningi bathi ucwaningo olwengeziwe luyadingeka ezinyathelweni zonke zohambo lwabantu abafuduka.
Ngokuqondile, kubalulekile ukucwaninga izici ezihilelekile empilweni yengqondo emazweni abantu abahlala kuwo, kodwa futhi isikhathi eside emazweni abo amasha.
Bengeza ukuthi uhambo lwabantu abasuka e-Afrika beya e-Europe ludinga ukunakekelwa okuningiliziwe kwabacwaningi.
Ucwaningo lolu lwaluyisivumelwano phakathi kwesayensi ehlala eNingizimu Afrika naseJalimani, futhi luyinxenye yencwadi ephathelene namava abafuduki base-Afrika abahlala emazweni aseYurophu.
Ukuba khona nokuhlala isikhathi eside kwe-Amblyomma hebraeum kukhuphula umthwalo we-Heartwater esifundeni eseningizimu yeBotswana.
I-Heartwater yisifo esithwalwa yizikhuli, esibangelwa yi-haemoparasite, esinokukhawula ukukhula kwamabhizinisi ezilimo eBotswana.
Lesiyingozi ekuphepheni kokudla kwesizwe kubangelwa ukukhiqizwa okuncane nokufa kwemfuyo ekulimbeni kokulima okuncane kunasemapulazini ezohwebo.
Ucwaningo lolu lubonisa ubunzima be-epidemiological ye-heartwater eBotswana.
Izikhuhlu ezondla ezilwaneni ezikhona ezigabeni ezine zaseNingizimu zaseBotswana zaziqondwe ngokuhlaziywa kokwakheka komzimba nokubunjwa kwamakhemikhali.
Abalimi bexoxiswe ngokuphathwa komthwalo we-heartwater ezigabeni zabo.
Imibiko yezimo zeklinikhi zezilwane yabuthwa ukuhlola ukwanda kwezimo kulo lonke isifunda saseNingizimu eBotswana.

Imiphumela yocwaningo iveze; ukusabalala okubanzi kwe-Amblyomma hebraeum kuzo zonke izindawo ezine ezifundwayo, ukwanda kancane konyaka ngonyaka kwezimo ze-heartwater eMoshupa, nokukhombisa ukwanda komthelela ezinhlotsheni zezimbuzi zasekhaya naphezu kokuzimisela kokulawula izinto eziphethe izifo ngama-63% abalimi abaqashwe.

I-Amblyomma hebraeum, umthwali oyinhloko we-Ehrlichia ruminantium eNingizimu Afrika, isabalalele kakhulu eSigabeni Eseningizimu saseBotswana futhi ngaleyo ndlela ibeka inselele ekukhiqizweni kwezifuyo kulesi sigaba, mhlawumbe, nakwezinye izindawo zezwe lapho i-tick ihlupha khona izifuyo.
Ngakho-ke, kunesidingo sokubuyekeza kabusha izindlela zokulawula izingwempu ezikhona ngenhloso yokunciphisa umthwalo wosulelelo lwe-heartwater, ikakhulukazi e-zimbhaneni nasezimpungwini.
Inani elikhulu lezinambuzane eNingizimu Botswana liyenza imbi kakhulu isifo se-heartwater ezilwaneni.
Lolu cwaningo lubika ngomthwalo obanzi wezikhukhula nesifo se-heartwater eNingizimu Botswana phakathi kuka-2017 no-2019.
Imiphumela yokucwaninga ingasiza uhulumeni nabalimi ukuba benze amacebo okulawula kangcono isifo se-heartwater.
Ezinye izikhonkwane zithwala ibhaktheriya ebizwa ngokuthi yi-Ehrlichia ruminantium, ebangela isifo esaziwa ngokuthi yi-heartwater ezinkomeni, eemvini nasezimbuzini.
Leli bakteri liyinhlanzi, okusho ukuthi liyadla ezinye izidalwa eziphilayo njengezilwane ezifuywayo, lilibangele ukulimala.
Izilwane ezifuyo ezina-heartwater, ngokuvamile zibe nokuqina komzimba okuphezulu, zilahlekelwe yisifiso sokudla, zibe nezinkinga zokuphefumula, futhi zingase zife ekugcineni.
I-Heartwater ivame kakhulu ingxenye eningizimu yeBotswana, futhi abalimi kuleyo ndawo bayalahlekelwa yizilwane zabo ngenxa yesifo.
Kulesifundo, abacwaningi bahlole umthwalo womgogodla eNingizimu Botswana.
Baqale ngokuqoqa, ukubala nokubona izikhuhlu ezinceleni, ezinganeni nasezimbuzini ukuze baqhathanise inani lezikhuhlu eziphethe i-parasite ye-heartwater nezinye izikhuhlu.
Abacwaningi baphinda bexoxa nabalimi abathile ngamava abo nge-heartwater, futhi baqoqe imibiko ethile ye-heartwater ehhovisi lezilwane (lempilo yezilwane).
Abacwaningi bathi izikhuhlane eziyingozi zazibanzi endaweni yocwaningo, nokuthi inani lezimboni zesifo se-heartwater likhuphuke unyaka nonyaka.
Baqoqe ama-tick angu-310 phakathi kuka-2017 no-2019.
Bathole izinhlobo ezintathu zezinambuzane: inambuzane yaseNingizimu Afrika, inambuzane enezinyawo ezimhlophe, kanye nenambuzane yembongolo ebomvu.
Eyona ivamile kwakuwukukhipha i-tick yaseNingizimu Afrika (85%), futhi yile ehambisa ibhaktheriya ebangela isifo senhliziyo.

Ezinye izinhlobo ezimbili zezinambuzane abazitholile azinayo indima ekusabalaleni kwesifo se-heartwater, kodwa zihlangene nezinye izifo zezilwane ezifuywayo ezifana ne-'theileriosis', 'anaplasmosis' ne-'babesiosis'.
Indawo eyayifundwa abacwaningi yayihlanganisa iGoodhope, iKanye, iMoshupa, neJwaneng.
Izimbungulu zaziningi eGoodhope, eKanye naseMoshupa.
Lezi zindawo zaziningi zinothile, zinamatshe futhi zinezitshalo eziningi.
IJwaneng, eyayinamanzi ambalwa kakhulu, yayomile, iluhlaza kakhulu futhi yayinezimila ezincane.
Abacwaningi bathi amarekhodi ezempilo yezilwane aveze icala lonke lamacala angu-42 e-heartwater eGoodhope, angu-38 eJwaneng, angu-75 eKanye, nangu-146 eMoshupa, kusukela ngo-2017 kuya ku-2019.
Abacwaningi bathi i-heartwater ithonye izimbuzi nezinkomo zasekhaya kakhulu kunokuhlasele izinhlobo ezivela kwamanye amazwe.
Bathe bakhuluma ukuthi abalimi benze imizamo ethile yokulawula izikhuli.
Ngokwesibonelo, u-63% wabalimi bahlanza izilwane ngezidakamizwa (amakhemikhali asetshenziswa ekubulaleni izinambuzane ezinjengezinyeketo).
Cishe ingxenye yesithathu (30%) yabalimi yasebenzisa amafutha ezilwaneni zabo ukulawula izikhuthazi, kanti abanye (7%) basebenzisa ukwakha izingadi ezintsha.

Abacwaningi bakuthola futhi ukuthi u-44% wabalimi abazange benze lutho ukusingatha isilwane esinecala, kuyilapho u-15% bathi babeyovakashela abasebenzi bezokwelapha izilwane ukuze bathole iseluleko, kodwa banikeza izilwane imithi ngokwabo.
Ngaphandle kokuba kwakukhona isifo sokuvimbela isifo se-heartwater, abacwaningi bathi u-93% abalimi abazange basisebenzise.
Abalimi batshela abacwaningi ukuthi kwakungenxa yokuthi babengafundiswanga nge-vaccine, futhi ngoba babengenakukwazi ukuyikhokhela i-vaccine.

Ezinye izifundo esikhathini esidlule zihlole indlela izingqengqele ezisasakazwa ngayo e-Afrika, kuhlanganise neBotswana, kodwa ngokusho kwabacwaningi, yabo kwaba yiyona yokuqala ukubheka ubudlelwano phakathi kwezingqengqele nezimpawu ze-heartwater eBotswana.

Bathe bathi amacala e-heartwater abhalwe odokotela bezilwane angase abe mancane kunamacala eqiniso abhekene nawo abalimi, ngoba odokotela bezilwane bavame ukuhlola nje isifo se-heartwater uma isilwane sifa, okusho ukuthi izilwane eziphila ngalesi sifo noma izilwane eziphulukile azibalwa njalo.
Abacwaningi baye baluleka ukuthi abalimi kufanele bafundiswe indlela yokulawula nokuphatha isifo se-heartwater ezinkomeni zabo, ukuze kuncishiswe umthwalo waso kule ndawo.
Baphinda bathi kufanele kwenziwe ucwaningo olwengeziwe ukuze kuqondwe izinto eziholela ekukhuleni kwama-tick.
Abacwaningi babehlala eBotswana.
Izithiyo Zokuhlola Okwenziwa Endaweni Yokunakekelwa E-India NaseNingizimu Afrika

Ukuhlolwa kwesikhathi (POC) emiphakathini, ezindlini, nasezikhungweni zezempilo eziyisisekelo kukholelwa ukuthi kunamandla amakhulu ekunciphiseni ukulibaziseka ekuxilongeni nasekuqaleni kokwelashwa kwezifo ezinjengobhubhane lwe-HIV, isifo sohlwempu, isifo sesifile, ne-malaria.

Ukuxilongwa okusheshayo nezinqumo zokuphatha okuqhubekayo okuqediwe ngesikhathi esifanayo sokuhlangana kwelapho noma okungenani ngosuku olufanayo, ngesikhathi isisulu silinde, kuthembisa ukunqoba ukulibaziseka okuhlobene nokuhlolwa okuvamile okusekelwe elabhorathorini.
Kodwa-ke, ukuba khona kokuhlolwa okuthengayo, okulula, nokusheshayo okungenziwa ngaphandle kwezindlu zokuhlola akuqinisekisi ngokuzenzakalelayo ukuphumelela kokuhlolwa kwe-POC.

Ukuze siqonde izindima ezintsha nezinselele ezihlangabezana nazo izinto zokwelapha ezinjengalezi, sidinga ukufunda ukuthi ukuxilongwa kusetshenziswa kanjani e-POC futhi kuhlanganiswe kanjani emsebenzini kanye nezinzila zabaguli.
Isahluko esilandelayo sibukeza imiphumela ekhethiwe evela ephrosektini yocwaningo olufanele mayelana nezingqinamba zokuhlola i-POC eNdiya naseNingizimu Afrika futhi luxoxa ngazo ngokulinganayo.

Le projekthi isebenzise izingxoxo ezingaqukatha izakhiwo ezithile kanye nezingxoxo zamaqembu okuqonda ukuhlola amasiko okuxilonga ezifundweni ezinkulu nezibonakaliso emakhaya, ezikhungweni zezempilo, emasikweni, ezibhedlela, nasezilabhorethri eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya.
Uma siqhathanisa imiphumela ekhethiwe, kucace ukuthi womabili amazwe anamasistimu ahlukile kakhulu okuxilongwa okuhlinzeka ngezimo ezihlukile kakhulu zokuhlola kwe-POC.
Isahluko siphetha ngokubhekwa kwendlela yokuthatha lezi zibonakaliso ezingqondweni lapho kuqanjwa izinhlelo zokuhlola i-POC.
Ukuhlolwa okubi kwezempilo ezindaweni zokunakekelwa eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya kulimaza ukunakekelwa kwezempilo.
Ukunakekelwa kwendawo (POC) kubhekisela ekuhlolweni kwezempilo okwenziwa endaweni efanayo lapho isigulane sithola khona ukunakekelwa, kunokuthumela amasampula esigulane kwenye ilaboratri yokuhlolwa.
INingizimu Afrika neNdiya azinikisi ukuhlolwa okusheshayo nokuphumelelayo ngenxa yezinhlelo zokusebenza ze-POC nezilabhoratri ezimbi.
Ukuhlolwa kwe-POC kuvumela iziguli ukuba zithole ukuhlolwa okusheshayo ngemiphumela esheshayo yokwelapha nokuphathwa kwezifo.
Lokhu kungenziwa ngemishini ephansi futhi elula engabuyisela imiphumela yokuhlola ngokushesha ngaphandle kokuthatha amasampula eziLabhorethri.
Kepha kuningi izingqinamba ezikhona ku-POC ezinciphisa ukunakekelwa kwabagula eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya.
Ababhali bafuna ukuqhathanisa ukuhlolwa kwe-POC eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya ukuze bakwazi ukubona izinkinga.
Baqhuba izingxoxo nemihlangano yamaqembu nabasebenzi bezempilo, iziguli kanye nezinkampani zezinto zokwelapha kusukela ngoSepthemba, 2012, kuya kuJuni, 2013, kuwo womabili amazwe.
Babuze ngezinqubo nezingqinamba ze-POC.
Esemphakathini wezempilo, eNdiya kusetshenziswa izilab ezincane eziningi futhi kwenziwa ukuhlolwa okuyisisekelo, kodwa lezi zilab azinikwa imali eyanele, ngakho-ke azinamakhambi anele okuhlola.
Asikhathi esiningi, abagulayo bayatshelwa ukuba babuyele ngolunye usuku noma baye kwenye indawo, okubangela izinkinga kubagulayo.
Abacwaningi baphawule futhi ukuthi ngezinye izikhathi abaguli bayahlolwa kodwa kuthatha isikhathi eside ukuthola imiphumela, futhi bathola kunzima ukuxhumana nodokotela wabo kamuva.
Ababambiqhaza bathi kufanele kube nezikhungo zokuhlola eziningi emagulini, nokuthi ukuhlolwa kungenziwa endaweni efanayo lapho iziguli zingena khona.
Baphinda bathi ukulandelela, ukwelashwa noma ukwelulekwa kufanele kwenzeke endaweni efanayo.
ENingizimu Afrika, bathole ukuthi ezinsizakalweni zempilo zeningi, inkampani eyodwa ilawula yonke ivivi, ngakho amasampula aya kule nkampani.
Ezinye izivivinyo ezilula zenziwa lapho kunethinta, futhi iziguli zithola imiphumela ngokushesha.
Uvivinyo lwe-HIV ne-TB luthatha isikhathi eside, ngakho-ke ukulandelela noma ukwelashwa kuphinde kulibale.
Ukubambezeleka okunye kungenxa yokuthutha, ukubhala amagama abaguli ngokungalungile, ukumarkisha amasampula ngokungalungile, nokuphazamiseka kwezinhlelo zekhompyutha.
Ekufuneni kwe-HIV, ezinye izilabhu zasebenzisa izindlela ezihlukene zokuhlola, futhi lokhu kunikeza imiphumela engenathembeko.

Bathole ukuthi iziguli zizama ukuhlolwa lwe-HIV ngokuya ngobubanzi bendawo noma uhlobo lokuhlolwa, futhi ngenxa yalokho ngezinye izikhathi zisebenzisa ikhadi lokuhlonza elihlukile, okubangela izinkinga uma kuzama ukuthola imihlangano yokulandelela.
Abacwaningi baphakamise ukuthi abasebenzi bezempilo kumele basebenzisane ukuze bahlanganyele umsebenzi.
Bathe bathi uma kukhona amakiti amasha okuhlola u-HIV, abasebenzi kufanele baqeqeshwe kabusha futhi izinhlelo kufanele zithuthukiswe.
Ababhali baqhathanise idatha ye-POC evela kuwo womabili amazwe futhi baphakamisa ukuthi iziphathimandla kufanele ziqaphele i-POC ngokufanele ngaphambi kokwengeza imikhiqizo emisha noma amadivayisi.
Baphinda bathi kufanele kube khona umzamo omkhulu wokubhekana nemisebenzi eminingi emakilabhu nasekufundeni indima umguli ayidlala ekunakekelweni kwempilo yakhe.
Ababhali bale ncwadi bevela eNingizimu Afrika, eNdiya, eCanada naseNetherlands.
Ukuya emazingeni okuchaza ukugula okunzima kanye nokukhathalelwa okunzima usebenzisa ukuhlaziywa komqondo.

Njengoba “ukugula okubalulekile” no “kunakekelwa okubalulekile” kungabi nazichazelo ezihambisanayo, ucwaningo olukhona luhlosile ukuhlola ukuthi imiqondo isebenziswa kanjani, lichaze izici zayo eziyinhloko futhi liphakamise izincazelo ezingasebenza.
Sisebenzise indlela kaWalker no-Avant yesinyathelo ngesinyathelo ekucwaningweni komqondo.
Ukusetshenziswa nokucaciswa kwemibono kutholwe ngokubuyekezwa kokubuka okubanzi kolwemibuzo kanye nokuhlalutya kwe-inthanethi kwabachwepheshe bezokwelapha emhlabeni jikelele abangu-114.
Ngokuhlaziya okuqukethwe kwedatha, sikhiphe amakhodi, izigaba nezihloko ukuze simise izimfanelo eziqondisa imiqondo, bese sichaza okungenzeka ukuthi kuyizichazamazwi.
Ukuze kusize ekuqondeni, sibonisa imodeli, izimo ezihlobene neziphambene eziphathelene nemibono, sibonile izimbangela nemiphumela yemibono, futhi saqondisa izinkomba zokulinganisa.

Izimpawu ezibalulekile ze-sickness ebuhlungu kwakuyingozi enkulu yokufa okusheshayo; ukungasebenzi kahle kwamalungu abalulekile; isidingo sokukhathalelwa ukuze kuvinjelwe ukufa; kanye nekhono lokubuyiselwa esimweni esijwayelekile.

Izici ezihlukanisayo zokunakekelwa okubalulekile kwakuwukubona, ukuqapha nokuphatha ukugula okubalulekile; ukusekela izitho ezibalulekile; ukunakekelwa okuqala nokuqhubekayo; noma yikuphi ukunakekelwa kokugula okubalulekile; kanye nemithombo yabantu neyezinto ezikhethekile.

Uchazo lwethu oluphakanyisiwe lobuhlungu obukhulu yilokhu: “simo sempilo embi esinekhuba ekuhlanganyeleni komzimba, ingozi enkulu yokufa okusheshayo uma ukunakekelwa kungabi khona, kanye nethuba lokubuyiselwa esimweni esiqondile.”

Uchazo lwethu oluphakanyisiwe lokunakekelwa okubalulekile yilokhu: “ukubona, ukuqapha nokuphatha iziguli ezinezinhlungu ezingathi sína ngokusekelwa kokuqala nokugcina kokusebenza kwamalungu abalulekile.”
Imibono yokugula okunzima kanye nokunakekelwa okunzima ayinawo amachaza-mzwelo avumelanayo futhi isebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene.

Ngokuhlaziywa kwemicabango yokusetshenziswa nokucaciswa kolwemi nezakwazi, sibonile izici eziqondisa lemicabango futhi siqagela izichazamazwi ezingasiza emisebenzini yezokwelapha, ucwaningo, nokwakha imiqondo.

Lo cwaningo lokuhlaziya imiqondo, yilona lokuqala ukuchaza ngendlela ehlelekileyo ukusetshenziswa nokucaciswa kwemiqondo yokugula okuyingozi kanye nokunakekelwa okuyingozi.

Ucwaningo lusebenzisa ukuhlola okubanzi kolwazi neminikelo evela kubachwepheshe bezokwelapha abangaphezu kwekhulu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene emhlabeni wonke ukuze kuqondwe izici ezibalulekile futhi kunikezwe incazelo ephakanyisiwe yemibono.

Kungenzeka ukuthi ezinye izindlela zokusetshenziswa nezincazelo zemiqondo ngezilimi ezingaphandle kwesiNgisi, ezincwadini ezingashicilelwanga nezingelona iphepha elilodwa, nasebenzabezempilo abangafakwanga kulokhu kuphenyo, azikwazanga ukubalwa.
Njengoba ukusetshenziswa kwamanje kwalezi zindlela kuhlukahlukene, izincazelo eziphakanyisiwe zingase zingamukeleki ngokubanzi futhi zihloselwe ukukhuthaza ingxoxo eyengeziwe.
Abacwaningi bahlela kabusha incazelo yabagula kakhulu kanye nokunakekelwa kwabo.
Imibhalo eqondile yokunakekelwa kwabagula esetshenziswa emhlabeni wonke ngabo bonke odokotela ingasiza ekunakekelweni kwabagula kakhulu.
Kulesi sifundo, iqembu labacwaningi bamazwe ngamazwe liphakamisa ukuthi “ukugula okukhulu” kufanele kusho ukuthi ngenkathi isiguli esigula sinenkambo enkulu yokufa, singaphila futhi.

Baphinda bathi “ukunakekelwa” okunikezwa iziguli ezigula kakhulu kufanele kusho noma yikuphi ukunakekelwa okunikezwa kusukela ngesikhathi zifika esibhedlela, kwaze kwaba yilapho zifa noma ziphulukile.
Akufanele nje kuphawule ukunakekelwa okusebenzisa imishini ekhethekile.
Esibhedlela, odokotela bavame ukubhekisela kubantu abagulayo kakhulu ngokuthi "abagulayo kakhulu," kanti ukunakekelwa nokwesekwa okudingekayo kulaba bantu kubhekisela "ekunakekelweni okukhulu."
Kodwa-ke, odokotela abasebenza ezigabeni noma ezibhedlela ezihlukene bayakuqonda ngokuhlukile la magama, ngoba incazelo yawo iyahlukahlukana endaweni ngayinye.
Lokhu kubangela, ngokwesibonelo, ukuba iziguli ezinezinhlungu ezifanayo zithole ukwelashwa noma ukunakekelwa okuhlukile, kuye ngokuthi ubani obasiza.
Amakhambi ahlukene enza kube nzima nakakhulu ohulumeni ukwazi inani langempela lezigulo ezingathi sína ezweni labo.
Kulesifundo, abacwaningi baqale bacwaninga ukuthi odokotela abahlukene babeqonde kanjani “ukugula okukhulu” nokuthi “ukunakekelwa okukhulu”, bese bephakamisa imiqondo eqondile kakhulu.
Baqoqe ulwazi ngokubuyekeza ezinye izincwadi ezinyathelisiwe.
Baphethisise futhi odokotela abavela emazweni ambalwa ahlukene emhlabeni wonke ababe nokuhlangenwe nakho ekwelapheni iziguli ezigula kakhulu.

Abacwaningi babhale ngezincazelo ezahlukene zezifo ezingathi sína, futhi baphawula ukuthi kwakuxhunyaniswe ngokuvamile nethuba elikhulu lokufa kwabagula; ezinye izingxenye zomzimba ezingasebenzi; isidingo sokunakekelwa ukuze kugwenywe ukufa; kanye nethuba lokuphulukana.
Endabeni yokushona nokuphulukana, amanye amazwi aveza ukuthi bonke abagulayo abakhulu bayogcina befile, kanti amanye aveza ithuba lokuthi umguli angaphulile naphezu kokuba nesifo esikhulu.

Ekugcineni, abacwaningi baphakamisa ukuchaza isifo esibuhlungu njengesifo lapho amalungu omzimba ayeka khona ukusebenza, lapho kunokwenzeka kakhulu ukuthi isiguli sizobulawa uma singanakekelwa kahle, kodwa kunethuba lokuphulukana.

Ekunakekelweni okubalulekile, odokotela babonakala bekuchaza ngendlela efanayo kakhulu, kodwa bahluke ngokuthi ukunakekelwa okunjalo kufanele kunikezwe kuphi, kanye nesidingo sezinto zokusebenza ezikhethekile.
Imithombo eminye ithi ukunakekelwa okubalulekile kungenzeka kuphela ezindaweni ezithile ezikhethekile esibhedlela ezinamakhulu amakhethekile.
Abanye bacabanga ukuthi ukunakekelwa okubalulekile kungafaka ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezikhethekile, kodwa kwakungeyona imfuneko.
Bathe bathi ukunakekelwa okubalulekile kungaphanwa ngisho nasemagumbini avamile esibhedlela, ezindaweni ezincane zezempilo, emphakathini noma ezigulini zezimoto zokulinda.
Bathe bathi ngisho nasezindaweni ezihlwempuzekile, iziguli ezigula kakhulu zidinga ukunakekelwa okubalulekile.

Ngakho-ke, abacwaningi baphakamise ukuthi ukunakekelwa okubalulekile kungachazwa njengonke ukunakekelwa okwenziwa kubantu abagulayo abanesifo esibuhlungu kusukela ekuqaleni kokubona ochwepheshe bezempilo ukuze bathole iseluleko kuze kube yilapho befa noma belulama.

Abacwaningi bathi lolu kwakuwuchungechunge lokuqala oluqoqe ulwazi ngezichazelo ezahlukene zezifo ezingathi sína kanye nokunakekelwa, nokuthi imiphumela yabo izosisiza ukuthuthukisa ukunakekelwa kwabantu abagulayo kakhulu.
Kodwa-ke bathi ucwaningo lwabo lungase lubekwe emkhawulweni yiqiniso lokuthi abazange basebenzise amachazamazwi avela kwezinye izilimi ngaphandle kwesiNgisi noma evela emithonjeni engashicilelwanga.
Baphinda futhi bahlangana nodokotela abambalwa emazweni ambalwa kuphela, ngakho-ke ukuhlaziya kwabo akubimeli wonke amazwe emhlabeni.
Abacwaningi, ababevela emanyuvesi aseMalawi, eTanzania, eSweden nase-UK, bathi incazelo yabo ephakanyisiwe ingashintshwa kakhulu uma kudingeka.
Ukuhlola okuhlanganisa i-genome yonke kwe-CRISPR-Cas9 kukhomba i-CENPJ njengomlawuli we-host wokuhlehliswa kokuhlelwa kwe-microtubule ngesikhathi sokutheleleka kwe-Plasmodium elapheni.

Ngaphambi kokuba kuqale ukubonakala kwezimpawu ze-malaria, i-Plasmodium sporozoite eyodwa iyaphethela i-hepatocyte bese ikhula ibe yizinkulungwane ze-merozoites, ngokwengxenye ngokusebenzisa imithombo yomzimba.
Sikhomba ukuthi ama-microtubules omphakathi ahlela kabusha ngendlela eguqukayo eduze kombhontshisi olukhula lwesigaba se-liver (LS).

Sisebenzisa isikrini se-genome-wide CRISPR-Cas9, sikhonjwe abalawuli be-host bokuhleleka kwe-cytoskeleton, ukuthutha kwe-vesicle, ukucindezeleka kwe-ER/Golgi kanye nokwenziwa kwe-lipid okulawula intuthuko ye-Plasmodium LS.

Lezi zilawuli ezintsha zokutheleleka, kuhlanganise ne-Centromere Protein J (CENPJ), zisibonise indlela yokubuza ukuthi ama-microtubule organizing centers (MTOCs) alawulwa kanjani ngesikhathi sokutheleleka.
Amaphuzu e-γ-tubulin abekwe emaphethelweni e-parasite; ukuncipha kwe-CENPJ kwakukhulisa leli-re-localization futhi kwandisa ukutheleleka.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, sibonisa ukuthi i-Golgi isebenza njenge-MTOC engasisona i-centrosomal ngokuhlela i-γ-tubulin nokukhuthaza ukwakheka kwe-microtubule emaphethelweni e-parasite.

Ngokuphelele, sikhomba ukuthi i-Plasmodium LS iqasha i-Golgi yomhlaba ukwakha izikhonkwane eziqhutshwa yi-MT lapho ama-organelles omhlaba ehlanganiswa khona kwi-PVM, ukuze kusekelwe ukuthuthukiswa kwesigaba sokwelula.
Umphumela wethu ubonisa ukuthi abavimbeli abaningi be-pharmacological abahlosekile ababungameli bangavimba ukutheleleka kwe-LS.
Oososayensi bafunda ukuthi ibhubhane liyawenza kanjani amaseli ukuze bazame ukwandisa izinketho zokwelapha.
Izimbangi eziningi zisebenzisa izondlo namandla amaseli ompehluleli wazo, umuntu noma isilwane, ukuze ziphinde ziphile.

Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi bathole i-jini ezithile eziqoka indima ekuthelelekeni yi-malaria emagumbini e-liver, okungase kuholele ezinhlosweni ezintsha zezidakamizwa zokulwa ne-malaria esikhathini esizayo.
I-Malaria yisifo esiyisibalo esikhulu nesingaholela ekufeni, esibangelwa yi-parasite ye-Plasmodium, esidluliselwa ngokuluma kwezinyosi.

Lapho kungena emzimbeni, iPlasmodium iyaluphalaza iqhubeke iye ethisini ukuze izale – le nqophamlando yokuqala ilungele ukwelashwa kwe-malaria ngoba ayikho izimpawu zesifo okwamanje futhi lesi sifo asinakudluliselwa.
Kulesifundo, abacwaningi bafuna ukuthola izinguquko ezithile ku-gene namaprotheni eeseli ze-liver ezine-infection ezinguqula indlela i-infection eyenzeka ngayo.
Besebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuguqula i-gene i-CRISPR-Cas9, abacwaningi bakwazile ukucima noma “ukukhipha” ama-gene athile ukuze babone ukuthi yiziphi izinguquko lapho lawo ma-gene engasebenzi.
Bese bayeka amasosha omkhuhlane e-malaria kuwo omabili amaseli e-liver ajwayelekile nawo “asusiwe”.
Lezi zikhamelo ezifana nezipayipi zihilelekile, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ekuhambeni kwezondlo nempahla ngaphakathi kwamaselula, futhi ngokuvamile zenza inethiwekhi eduze komsuka weseli.

Esinye sezinto ezibalulekile ezitholakele yikuthi iPlasmodium ithatha ngamandla ama-microtubules emagumbini e-liver – esikhundleni sokuba ama-microtubules abuthane eduze nenuzi, ehambisa izondlo nezinto ezidingekayo lapho iseli ikudingayo, ama-microtubules abuthana eduze ne-parasite, ehambisa izondlo nezinto ezidingekayo ukuze kusize i-parasite ukuzala.

Abacwaningi babone ukuthi lapho beqeda iphrotheni ebizwa nge-CENPJ, i-parasite yaba yimpumelelo kakhulu ekuqoqeni ama-microtubules eduze kwayo, futhi ama-parasite akhula amakhulu futhi enza amakhophi amaningi awo.
Izazi zesayensi zithole futhi amanye ama-gene amaningana athonya ukuthi ukutheleleka kwe-plasmodium kubi kangakanani.
Abacwaningi bakhombise ngaphambili ukuthi ezinye izinambuzane zihlanganisa kabusha ama-microtubules ukuze ziguqule izinto eziphilayo ngaphakathi kwebanga ukuze zizise kuzo.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi baqinisekisile ukuthi izinambuzane ze-Plasmodium zingase futhi zisebenzise le nkambiso ukuqondisa kabusha izondlo namanye amathuluzi ekukhuleni kwazo.
Kusasa, ososayensi bathemba ukusebenzisa ukuqonda kwabo kokuthi ama-gene nama-parasite ahlangana kanjani ngaphakathi kwamaselula ukuze bathole ukwelashwa okusha kwe-malaria.

Nakuba abacwaningi babone ushintsho oluthakazelisayo kwezinto eziphila emakhaleni e-liver phakathi kwezinyathelo zokuqala ze-malaria, kunesidingo somsebenzi omningi ukuqonda ukuthi i-Plasmodium ishintsha kanjani ikhemikhali yeseli kanye nomsebenzi ukuze kutholakale imigomo ethile yemithi.
Amakhulu ezinkulungwane zokufa aqhubeka nokwenzeka unyaka ngamunye ngenxa yemalaria, inani elikhulu lawo lise-Afrika.

Ngokusho kweQembu Lezempilo Lomhlaba, ngaphezu kuka-90% lamacala e-malaria emhlabeni ngo-2019 kwenzeka e-Afrika, okwenza lokhu kube yinkinga ebalulekile edinga imizamo eqhubekayo yokuqapha nokungenela.
Ukufika Kwezitshalo Nezitsha Ezingaphandle njengengxenye Yomzamo Wokucwaninga Ngokushintsha Komhlaba eNingizimu Afrika
Kulesi sahluko, siqapha ukuthi ucwaningo olungakanani eNingizimu Afrika luqondiswe ekungeneni kwezidalwa ezingaphandle ngokubhekisela kwezinye izici zoshintsho lomhlaba.

Sisebenzisa i-Web of Science, sibuyekezile ngendlela ehlelekile izincwadi ezifanele ezinhlelweni zemvelo zaseNingizimu Afrika ezinyatheliswe phakathi kuka-2000 no-2018 futhi ezihlobene nokungena kwezinhlobo zasendle, ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu, ukuqothulwa ngokweqile, ukushintsha kwendawo yokuhlala, ukungcoliswa, kanye/noma i-CO2 emkhathini.
Sithole amaphepha afanele angu-1149 ahlanganiswe ngokwemigomo yabo yokumboza abashayeli kanye nokuhlangana kwabashayeli okunethelela ekuhlukahlukenyeni kwemvelo noma izinsizakalo ze-ecosystem.
Kutholakale umphumela onamandla wendawo nesikhathi emizamweni yocwaningo.

Okokuqala, umzamo wahlukene phakathi kwezindawo, ngokushintsha kwendawo yokuhlala, ukungcoliswa nokudla okweqile okuthola ukugxila okukhulu kocwaningo emazweni asemanzini, amanzi amnandi nasemanzini olwandle/emilonyeni ngokulandelana.
Okwesibili, izimpawu ezithile ezifundwe kahle emhlabeni jikelele azibhalwanga ezincwadini zendawo (um., kwakunemiqulu engaphansi kwehlanu mayelana nokubanda kolwandle).

Sikhonjwe ukusebenzisana okuhlukile okungu-21 phakathi kwabaqhubi, kanti ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlobo ezihlaselayo kanye nokuchaneka kwendawo yokuhlala (isibonelo izimo eziguqukile zomlilo ezindaweni ezihlaselekile) kuyinto evelele kunazo zonke.
Kodwa-ke, okungaphansi kuka-4% wezincwadi ezazikhuluma ngokusebenzisana phakathi kwabashayeli abathathu noma ngaphezulu.

Lokhu kusikisela ukuthi ngenkathi kubalulekile ukuqonda ukusebenzelana kwabadali, kuncane kakhulu okwenziwe ngokucwaninga imiphumela ehlanganisiwe yokusebenzelana kwabadali ezinhlelweni ze-ecosystem zaseNingizimu Afrika.

Ukusikisela okuye kwaphawulwa isikhathi eside ukuthi izinhlobo ezihlaselweyo ziyingozi yesibili enkulu kunazo zonke ekulondolozeni ukwahlukahluka kwemvelo, ngemuva kokushintsha kwendawo yokuhlala, kuhambisana nokukhiqizwa kocwaningo oluhambisanayo lolu phawu eNingizimu Afrika.

Ukukhula isithombe esibanzi sokubala kokubaluleka kwabashayeli bokuguquka komhlaba kuzoba inselele, akuyona nje ekucaciseni okungathandabuzeki kwabashayeli, kodwa futhi ngenxa yokungalingani kokutholakala kwemiphumela yocwaningo ezilinganisweni zesikhathi nezindawo ezifanayo.
Ukuvuthwa okuqondene komsebenzi mayelana nezinhlobo ezihlaselayo kungaba yisisekelo sokuphenya ukusebenzelana okunjalo okunzima futhi ngaleyondlela kusize ekuqedeni izithiyo ezinjalo.
Abacwaningi kumele bamape ithonya ehlangene lezinambuzane ezingena ezindaweni, ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu nemisebenzi yabantu eNingizimu Afrika.

Izinhlobo ezihlaselayo yisongo lesibili elikhulu ekulondolozeni ukwahlukahluka kwemvelo eNingizimu Afrika - iqiniso elihambisana, kubikwa abacwaningi, nenani lephepha locwaningo elikwenziwe ngale ndaba.
Lokhu kuhambelana nezinye izingozi ezifana nokungcoliswa, ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu, ukubulala ngokweqile noma ukushintsha kwendawo yokuhlala.

Lezi zingozi ezisongela izindawo eziphilayo yilokho ososayensi ababiza ngokuthi abashayeli bezinguquko zomhlaba wonke, okuyisifundo sendlela umhlaba, njengesimiso, oshintsha ngayo ngokusebenzisana konke phakathi kwemisebenzi yabantu nezinye izinqubo zokwenyama, zekhemikhali nezobiological.

Kwesihloko sencwadi yakamuva, abacwaningi bahlole ukuthi kuncwaningiswa kangakanani eNingizimu Afrika ngokuhlasela kwezinto eziphilayo, lapho izinhlobo ezifana nezitshalo noma izilwane zifakwa endaweni entsha lapho zikhula khona, zimi khona futhi zingaze zonakalise ezinye izinhlobo ezizungezile noma imvelo.
Baphethe futhi ngocwaningo lokusebenzisana kwalolu shoshovu nabanye abashayeli.
Bekuhlola izincwadi zocwaningo ezinyatheliswe phakathi kuka-2000 no-2018 kudeshibhesi ye-“Web of Science”, bathole izifundo ezifanele ezingama-1149.

Ukubuyekezwa kwabo kwizifundo kwakhombisa ukuthi ucwaningo olusekelwe ezweni (olwasemhlabeni) lugxile kakhulu ekuchithweni kwendawo yokuhlala, kuyilapho ucwaningo lwezamanzi amnandi lugxile ekungcoliseni, kanti ucwaningo lolwandle ne-estuary lubukele kakhulu ukukhahlela ngokweqile.
Baphethe futhi ukuthi izimpawu ezibhalwe kahle emhlabeni wonke ukuthi zithinta ukwahlukahluka kwemvelo noma izinsizakalo ze-ecosystem, azibhalwanga kahle ekuhloleni kwendawo yaseNingizimu Afrika.
Isibonelo, bathole kuphela izincwadi eziyi-5 ezibuka ukwanda kokubila kolwandle, okuyaphula izintambo zokudla futhi konakalise impilo yolwandle.
Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba ikhabhoni dayoksayidi elikhulu emoyeni, evela emisebenzini yabantu njengokushisa amalahle, lixazululeka emanzini olwandle.
Ukushintsha kwendawo yokuhlala, njengomlilo noma ukushintsha kwesimo sezulu, kuholela ekukhuleni kwezinhlobo ezingena ngokungemthetho.
Bathe bathi ikhabhoni dayoksayidi ikhuphuke cishe ngamaphesenti angu-40, futhi kungenzeka ukuthi idala izimo ezinhle zokukhula kwemifino yasezweni langaphandle.
Kepha, kunocwaningo oluncane kakhulu oluenziwe kule ndaba eNingizimu Afrika.
Bathole amaphepha angu-21 abheka indlela abashayeli abahlukene abaxhumana ngayo.
Iningi lalezi zazigxile ekuxhumaniseni izinguquko zehlathi nezinhlobo ezihlaselwe.
Kodwa-ke, amaphepha ambalwa kakhulu abhekile kubashayeli abangu-3 noma ngaphezulu ngesikhathi esifanayo.
Ababhali bathi lokhu kusikisela ukuthi ucwaningo olwengeziwe mayelana nendlela abashayeli bokuhluka kwemvelo abaxhumana ngayo ukuthinta izinhlelo zekhaya kudingeka eNingizimu Afrika.

Ababhali baseNingizimu Afrika bayavuma ukuthi kuyoba nzima ukuthuthukisa umbono ophelele wokuthi abashayeli bezinguquko zasemhlabeni bahlangana kanjani eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa bathi ucwaningo lwendabuko olukhona lwezinhlobo ezingena ngokungemthetho seluyingxenye yokuqondisa izifundo kule ndawo enzima.
Izici zezwe eziphatha indaba yokuhlanganiswa komhlaba onobunzima kanye nokugcinwa kwe-C ehlathini laseMiombo, eZambia.
Izinto eziphilayo zomhlabathi (SOM) iyona yingxenye ebalulekile yokukhiqiza kwamahlathi kanye nesitoreji se-carbon ephilayo yomhlabathi.

Kodwa-ke, kuncane okwaziwayo mayelana nokuhlukahluka kwe-SOM ne-C ehlathini laseMiombo, eliyisiko-moya elibalulekile ehlathini lase-Afrika esingaphansi kweSahara futhi libalulekile ezindleleni ze-REDD+.
Kulesifundo, izici ezingu-9 zomhlabathi zilinganiselwe futhi zasetshenziswa ukuhlaziya ukuguquguquka kwe-SOM ezindaweni zasehlathini laseMiombo ezinezakhiwo zamahlahla ezihlukene eLuanshya, eZambia.
Okutholakele kukhombise ukuguquguquka okukhulu kwamathunzi e-SOM ekujuleni komhlabathi okuhlukene:

Ama-36.67 kuya ku-113.89 Mg ha-1 kubunzima obusezingxenyeni ezingama-0–10 cm, ama-28.67 kuya ku-79.56 Mg ha-1 kubunzima obusezingxenyeni ezingama-10–20 cm, nama-31.89 kuya ku-98.56 Mg ha-1 kubunzima obusezingxenyeni ezingama-20–30 cm.

Lezi zindinganiso ze-SOM ekujuleni okuhlukene nazo zahlukahluka ezindaweni zasehlathini laseMiombo ezisezinyathelweni ezahlukene zokulandelana, ikakhulukazi ukuthi izindawo ezithintekile yisuswa samithi yakamuva zazinokuqukethwe kwe-SOM okuphezulu kunokulinganiselwe ngaphezulu kwesendlalelo (0–10 cm: +5.57%; 10–20 cm: +4.20%; 20–30 cm: +4.30%).

Uhlalutyo oluhambisanayo oluqondile (CCA) lubonise ukuthi izici ezibaluleke kakhulu zemvelo eziphazamisa i-SOM kwakuwukuncishiswa kwehlathi ngokususwa kwamahlathi, kanye nokuqukethwe kobumba emhlabathini.

Ucwaningo lolu lubonisa ukuthi i-CCA ingasetshenziswa ukubonisa ukubaluleka okulinganiselwe kwezinyathelo ezahlukene zokukhula kwehlathi njengomsebenzi wezindlela zokuphatha, kanye nezici ze-edaphic, ekuqondeni okuqukethwe kwe-SOM yomhlabathi we-miombo.

Imiphumela yalesi sifundo ibaluleke kakhulu ekubhekaneni neqhinga lamanje le-REDD+ lokutshala imithi kabusha nokuphathwa kwamahlathi okuqondiswe ekwandiseni amasitoke ekhabhoni ehlathini lase-Afrika eseningizimu yeSahara.
Sithi ososayensi abafunda izinkuni zaseZambia, ukukhahlela imithi ngokucophelela kuyaqeda ukulungisa umhlabathi.
Abacwaningi bathi izindawo ezicwiliwe zasehlathini kanye nezinsimbi zehlathi eZambia zazinento eningi ephilayo, okusho ukuthi umhlabathi unenkulu.
Kubalulekile ukuqonda ikhwalithi yomhlabathi e-Afrika eseningizimu yeSahara ngoba ithonya kakhulu indlela izitshalo nezihlahla ezikhula ngayo.
Uluhlaza lunenutriyenti ezahlukene, futhi izinto eziphilayo nezilimo yizona ezibaluleke kakhulu ekusizeni izitshalo ukuba zikhule kahle.
Izinto eziphilayo yizinto ezisemhlabeni ezivela esaleni sezitshalo nezilwane ezifile.
Ngaphezulu kwengxenye (58%) yento ephilayo iyikhabhoni nje, bese okunye kuyamanzi namanye ama-nutrients.
Uluhlaza olunezinhlu zokuphila eziningi, kanye nekhaboni ngakho-ke, lugcina amanzi isikhathi eside futhi lunezinye izondlo eziningi.
Ososayensi abanawo ulwazi oluningi ngezinguquko zezinto eziphilayo nekhaboni ezingosini zase-Afrika eseningizimu yeSahara, yize zibalulekile kakhulu ekukhuleni kwezitshalo nemithi.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi bafuna ukuthola ukuthi indaba yezinto eziphilayo emhlabathini ehlathini ishintshe kanjani, nokuthi yini ebeka inani lazo.
Benze ucwaningo lwabo ehlathini eZambia.
Baqoqe amasampula omhlabathi phezulu (0-10 cm), phakathi (10-20 cm), nasezindaweni ezijulile (20-30 cm), nakwezinye izindawo ezahlukene zasehlatini.
Abacwaningi base behlwaya uthuli e-laboratri ekugcineni ukuhlola ukuthi lunobunzima kangakanani be-organic matter.
Ilaboratri yi-indawo lapho ososayensi benza khona ukuhlola nokuhlola, ngokuvamile basebenzisa imishini enembile yokulinganisa izinto ezithile.
Baphinda babhala phansi ezinye izimfanelo zomhlabathi njengohlobo lwawo, ngokwesibonelo oluhlabathi olukhulu noma olufana nodongwe.
Imiphumela yabo yakhombisa ukuthi inani le-organic matter lahluka kakhulu ezindaweni ezihlukene, nasemazingeni ahlukene.
Uluhla lwezwe oluphezulu lwalunomthamo ophezulu kakhulu wolwemi oluphilayo olufinyelela kumagremu angu-114 (mg) ngehektha, okulandelelwa yilutho olujulile (cishe amagremu angu-100 ngehektha).
Uluhla lwezwe oluphakathi lwalunobuningi obuncane obufinyelela ku-80 mg ngehektha.
Abacwaningi bathi izindawo ehlathini ezazisanda kuhlanzwa zinezinto eziphilayo eziningi kunezindawo ezingakahlanzwa.
Baphinde baphakamise ukuthi ukuthungatha izimithi ehlathini, ngokuphathwa okucophelelekile, kungandisa inani le-organic matter emhlabathini.

Abacwaningi baphawula futhi ukuthi umbala womhlabathi washintsha ukusuka obumnyama obukhulu (umhlabathi ophezulu) uya kobumnyama obukhanyayo (umhlabathi ojulile), nokuthi imihlabathi yethanga kanye nemihlabathi yobumba yayinento eningi enhle.
Izindawo ehlathini ezazivulekele ukukhanya kwelanga zazinamahlathi amakhulu amadala, kanye nezinto eziphilayo eziningi.
Abacwaningi, ababekhona eZambia naseNingizimu Afrika, bathi izindlela zabo zingaguqulwa abanye ukuze bahlole ikhwalithi yomhlabathi ezindaweni ezahlukene nasemazingeni ahlukene.
Ukuthuthukisa Ukukhiqizwa Kwekheshi Nokukhiqiza Ngokusebenzisa Indlela Yezinkundla Zokwakha Zabahlanganyeli e-Ethiopia
I-Chickpea (Cicer arietinum L.) yiyona ingxenyekazi yokudla ebalulekile yesithathu kokubili ngendawo kanye nokukhiqizwa ngemuva kwama-beans avamile nama-faba beans e-Ethiopia.
Kodwa-ke, ukukhiqiza komkhiqizo kwakuncane kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa namandla awo ngenxa yokungasetshenziswa kwezinhlobo ezithuthukisiwe nezindlela ezidalwe yisikhungo socwaningo.

Ukuthuthukisa ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe nobuhlobene nocwaningo, i-National Chickpea Stakeholders Innovation Platform yasungulwa ngo-2013 enenjongo yokubuthana ngezinhlangothi ezahlukene ezihlanganyela ochungechungeni lokukhiqiza ukuze kuhlonishwe inselele ezinkulu futhi kutholakale izixazululo ezizosetshenziswa ngemizamo ehlangene.
I-platform ibonile ukushoda kwembewu njengesiqathuli esikhulu kulesi sici.
Le nkinga iye yakhonjiswa ngokwakha amaqembu abalimi abakhiqizi bembewu ngosizo lwabalingani be-R&D, futhi njengamanje yibona abahlinzeki abakhulu ezweni lonke.
Beqala, leli qhathaniso liqinisile umzamo wokwandisa futhi laqalisa ukusakazwa kwezobuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe kubalimi abaningi.
Ngenxa yalokho, ukukhiqiza komkhiqizo wabalimi abayizibonelo kwanda kakhulu kube kane, futhi ukukhiqiza kwesizwe kuphindwe kabili kwaze kwaba yi-2 ton ha−1 kuleli khulu leminyaka eledlule.
Leli qhathaniso liphinde lasebenza ekulungiseni ukufinyelela emakethe futhi muva nje i-chickpea ijoyine imakethe ye-Ethiopian Commodity Exchange.
Ngokubaqaphela amathuba amakhulu okukhula kwesilimo, leli qembu lizama ukuqinisa ngokwengeziwe ukungenelela futhi liqoqe amathuba.
Indlela i-Ethiopia eyandisa ngayo ukukhiqizwa kwamaqhawe.
Abacwaningi bachaze ukuthi i-Ethiopia yandisile ukukhiqizwa kwamaqanda ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi abalimi banokufinyelela ezimbini ezithuthukisiwe kanye nokuqeqeshwa ngezindlela zokulima ezithuthukisiwe.
Isikhowe yisitshalo sokudla esifana nebhinca esivunwa kakhulu e-Ethiopia.
Iningi lemikhiqizo yezwe lithunyelwa kwamanye amazwe.
Eminyakeni eminingi edlule, abantu abaningi baqaphela ukuthi abalimi bangakhiqiza amantongomane amaningi uma besebenzisa imbewu eyenziwe ngcono ezohlala iphila izinambuzane nezifo.
Incwadi yakamuva ichaza ukuthi ukukhiqizwa kwamaqanda ase-Ethiopia kuye kwanda kusukela kulokho kuqondwa.
Ababhali bathi ngo-2013, i-Ethiopia yakha i-“National Chickpea Stakeholders Innovation Platform” eyaxoxa ngezinkinga zokukhiqiza i-chickpea futhi yaveza izixazululo.
I-platform ifana nenhlangano.
Ipulatifomu yayifaka abacwaningi, uMnyango wezoLimo wase-Ethiopia, amaqembu abalimi kanye nezinhlangano, abenzi bokudla, abakhiqizi bembewu, nabalingani bokuthumela kwamanye amazwe.
Ababhali bathi isiteji sabona ukushoda kwembewu njengesinye sezinselelo ezinkulu, bese bakha izinhlangano zokunikeza imbewu kulo lonke izwe.
Lokhu kushintsha kwaphinde kabili ukukhiqizwa kwamaqabunga kwaze kwaba yiyithoni ezimbili ngehektha.
Omunye umsebenzi ababewubone kwakuwukuntuleka kokukhulu kwemikhiqizo.
Bafundise abalimi ngezindlela zokukhiqiza ezingcono, njengokusebenzisa umanyolo ukuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yomhlabathi.
Baphawule futhi ukuthi abalimi bahlupheka ukulawula ukhula.

Ngakho-ke banike abafama imbewu yeqhwa elihluma kahle ngisho noma lihlatshelwe ngezidakamizwa zezinye izitshalo, ezingamakhemikhali abafama abawasebenzisayo ukulawula ukhula noma izitshalo ezingafuneki.
Ababhali bathi i-platform yenza isiqiniseko sokuthi abalimi bayeqeqeshwa ukuze bakhulise ulwazi lwabo mayelana nokukhiqizwa kwamaqanda.
Abalimi nabo babekhona emicimbini lapho bebelingana khona ulwazi namava abo.
Ababhali bathi i-platform ihlanganisa abalimi nabathengi, kanye nabakhiqizi bembewu nalabo ababophekile ekuthengeni nasekusabalaliseni imbewu kubalimi.
I-platform ibuye yakha futhi yaqeqesha izinhlangano zabesifazane nabasha ekukhiqizeni i-chickpea.
Baphinde bakhuthaza abesifazane nabasha ukuba bahlanganyele ekukhiqizeni imbewu.
Ababhali bathi naphezu kokuthi kufezwe okuningi, kusasekhona ukushoda kwembewu yebhinya.
Baphinda bathi i-platforming ingathola okwengeziwe uma ngabe inezinsiza zokuhlangana njalo.
Bacebisa ukuthi uMnyango wezoLimo wase-Ethiopia nabacwaningi kufanele basekele isiteji ngemali ukuze ingawi.
Baphinda basikisela ukuthuthukiswa kokulingana kwamaqanda kanye nendlela okuqondwa ngayo ingozi yokukhiqizwa kwamaqanda, njengezifo.
Ekugcineni, ababhali babize ukufuna imbewu eyenziwe ngcono ngokwengeziwe ezobe kulula ukuyivuna ngemishini, futhi ebingathinteki yizidakamizwa zezinhlanga.
Uhlobo oluhlukile lwe-SARS-CoV-2 lineage A (A.23.1) olunezinguquko ze-spike luvela futhi lubusa isifo samanje sase-Uganda.
Ukubhekwa kwe-genome ye-SARS-CoV-2 e-Uganda kunikeza ithuba lokwenza incazelo egxile ekuthuthukeni kwe-virus ezweni elincane lase-Afrika eseMpumalanga elingenayo ulwandle.

Lapha sibonisa ushintsho lwamuva olukhona ekuhambeni kwesifo kule ndawo, ngohlobo olusha oluvela i-A.23 oluguqukela ku-A.23.1 oluqondisa manje amacala ase-Uganda futhi selusakazeke kwamanye amazwe angu-26.
Nakuba izinguquko eziqondile ze-A.23.1 njengoba iziqondanise zihlukile kunalokho okusezinhlanganweni ezikhathazayo (VOC), ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kubonisa ukuhlangana kusethi efanayo yamaprotheni.

Indawo yokubhala iphrotheni ye-spike ye-A.23.1 iqoqele ukuguqulwa okufana nokuningi kokuguqulwa okubonwayo ku-VOC okuhlanganisa ukuguqulwa endaweni engu-613, ukuguqulwa endaweni yokuhlukanisa i-furin okwandisa i-motif ye-amino acid esuselwe, kanye nokuguqulwa okuningi endaweni ye-N-terminal ephakamayo.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-A.23.1 lineage iqukethe izinguquko eziphrotein ezingezona ze-spike ezivela kwezinye i-VOC (i-nsp6, i-ORF8 ne-ORF9).

Uthintaka lwezokwelapha lwe-A.23.1 variant akusacaci, kodwa kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokulandelela ngokucophelela le variant, kanye nokulinganisa ngokushesha imiphumela yokuguqulwa kwe-spike protein ekusebenzeni kwe-vaccine.
Abacwaningi babika ngokuthuthuka kwe-SARS-CoV-2 e-Uganda.
Ngo-2021, abacwaningi babike ukuthi uhlobo olusha lwe-SARS-CoV-2, i-virus ebangela i-Covid-19, luvelele e-Uganda futhi lwase lwesabekela kwamanye amazwe angu-26.
Bayibize leli-variant ngokuthi “A.23.1”, bathi inezinguquko eziningi ezifanayo kumaprotheni abacwaningi abaye bawabona kwezinye izinhlobo ezikhathazayo emhlabeni jikelele ngalesi sikhathi.
Oososayensi balandelela ukuthi izinhlobo ze-coronavirus ziguquka kanjani ukuze baqonde kangcono ukuthi izigqoko zisebenza kangcono kanjani ezinhlotsheni ezintsha.
I-Covid-19 ibulele abantu abaningi emhlabeni jikelele.
Enqubweni eyaziwa ngokuthi ukulandelela i-genome, ososayensi balandela indlela i-genetics namaprotheni e-virus ashintsha ngayo njengoba isakazeka.
Bayasebenzisa lolu lwazi ukulawula isifo nokuqondisa ukuthuthukiswa kwe-vaccine.
Isibonelo, ngokuqonda ubukhulu bephrotheni ze-spike ze-virus, abacwaningi bangakha ama-vaccine azobopha kangcono leziphrotheni ukuze kuvimbelwe i-virus ukungena ezicellini zabantu.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi babheke ngokukhethekile indlela i-SARS-CoV-2 eyayithuthuka ngayo e-Uganda.
Abacwaningi baqonde uhlu lwe-genetic lwale virusi emasampuleni okutholakele ku-COVID-19 e-Uganda.

Basebenzise isofthiwe yekhompyutha ukuze balandele umlando (noma umlando womndeni) wohlobo olusha abalubonile ngale ndlela (oluthiwa yi-A.23.1), futhi bakwazi ukubona ukuthi uhlobo olufana kanjani nomuthi womndeni we-SARS-CoV-2.
Imiphumela yabo yakhombisa ukuthi uhlobo lwe-A.23.1 luye lwathuthuka muva nje kwenye uhlobo oluthiwa yi-A.23, futhi lwafunyanwa ku-90% yazo zonke izibonelo ezitholakele.
Ngamanye amazwi, bekuyibusayo emasampuleni ase-Uganda kusukela ngo-Okthoba 2020.
Baphethe futhi ukuthi uhlobo lwe-A.23.1 lwalunezinguquko eziningi eprotheni ye-spike ezifana nezinye izinguquko ezibonwe kwezinye izinhlobo ezinesizungu.
Lezi zinguquko cishe zenza uhlobo oluguqukile ludluliseke kalula (ludabuka ngokushesha), futhi lube nokumelana okuqine kakhulu neziqondiso zokugonywa kanye namakhambi.
Ucwaningo lolu luwengeza emizamweni eqhubekayo yokulandelana kwezinhlobo ze-SARS-CoV-2 emhlabeni jikelele.
Imiphumela iyakwengeza ebufakazini obukhula bokuthi i-SARS-CoV-2 ithuthuka ngokushesha njengoba isakazeka iphethe abantu abaningi futhi iziqede izibulala-magciwane.
Kodwa-ke, ucwaningo olwengeziwe luyadingeka ukuqonda ukuthi yini ngempela imiphumela noma imisebenzi yokushintsha kwe-spike protein e-A.23.1 variant.
Abacwaningi bayekazelela ukuqapha okwengeziwe kwe-genome ukuze kusisize siqonde ukuthi izinhlobo ze-virus ziphendula kanjani ezibulaleni ezikhona e-Uganda nakwamanye amazwe.
Bathi futhi ukuqapha uhambo lwamazwe ngamazwe kubalulekile ukuze abacwaningi baqonde kangcono indlela i-virus esakazekayo ngayo endaweni.

Abasebenzi bezempilo nabazali badlala indima ebalulekile ekwenzeni izinqumo eziphathelene ne-FGM/C kuzo zonke izindawo.
EKhenya, ikakhulukazi, abesifazane abasebasha bayaxoxisana ngendima yabo ekwenzeni izinqumo eziphathelene ne-FGM/C njengoba sebelikhulu ngesikhathi sokusoka.

Ucwaningo lubonisa ukuthi izimo zomthetho nemiphakathi eguqukayo kuyo yonke indawo ziletha izinguquko ensimini yokugoqa i-FGM/C, okuholela ekwelashweni kwe-FGM/C e-Indonesia, ekuqaleni kweminyaka yokugoqa amantombazane eKenya, nasekuqhubekeni kwayo ngasese kwe-FGM/C e-Ethiopia.
Lezi zimo ezintathu zibonisa ukwahluka okukhulu endabeni yokusilela i-FGM/C kanye nencazelo yomphakathi ehambisana nayo kubantu abasebasha nabathandawo.
Kunendingeko yokuhlola ngokujulile indima yabazali ekwenzeni izinqumo.

Ngenxa yezixhumanisi phakathi kwabashayeli abahlukene be-FGM/C kuyo yonke ingqikithi, ucwaningo luphetha ngokuthi amasu athile okungqikithi kufanele athathelwe ezingxenyeni zokwenza ushintsho oluhlala njalo.
Ukuyeka ukusoka kwabesifazane, okokuqala kudingeka siqonde ukuthi kungani kwenzeka.

Ukuhlukunyezwa kwesini somfazi, umkhuba lapho izingxenye zezitho zesini somfazi zigezwa khona noma zisuswe, kusawenzeka ngokungekho emthethwini noma ngasese emazweni afana neKenya, i-Ethiopia ne-Indonesia.

Ezingxenyeni zase-Afrika nase-Asia, ukunqunyulwa kwezilwane zesifazane (FGM), okuthi ngezinye izikhathi kubizwe ngokuthi ‘ukusoka kwabesifazane’, kusawenziwa ngokujwayelekile.

Abantu abaningi bakholelwa ngamanga ukuthi i-FGM iyadingeka ukuze kube nokuhlanzeka okuhle noma ukuze abesifazane bahlale bezothile (bengabi nazithukutheki futhi bethobekile), nokuqinisekisa ukuthi bazokwazi ukuba nezingane.
Ngokwesifakazi sesayensi, ukusoka kwabesifazane akudingeki kunoma yikuphi kula.

Kepha, ezimweni eziningi, abantwana abaphathwe nge-FGM baphela bebenobungeempilo ezingozini kamuva ekuphileni, njengezifo ezilimazayo, ukuzithola kunzima ukuthimba (ukuphuma kwamanzi), nezingqinamba zempilo yengqondo.
Ngenxa yokuthi leyo nqubo iyingozi kakhulu futhi iphula amalungelo abantu besifazane, amazwe amaningi ayenze ingasekho emthethweni, kodwa abantu basaphikelela ngasese.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi bafuna ukuqonda okwengeziwe ngokuthi kungani i-FGM yenzeka emazweni ahlukene, nokuthi abantu bakholelwa ini ngaleli qhezu.
Ngakho-ke baqoqe ulwazi mayelana nokugoma i-FGM eKenya, e-Ethiopia nase-Indonesia.

Kusuka kulezi zitshalo ezirekhodiwe, ezingu-140 (58.6%) zazinhlobo ezisetshenziswa ezintweni eziphathelene nemvelo, ezingu-84 (35%) izitshalo zokudla, ezingu-83 (34.7%) izinhlobo zezitshalo zokwelapha, ezingu-39 (16.3%) izinhlobo zekhukhwini, ezingu-57 (23.8%) izitshalo ezisetshenziswa ezinto, ezingu-60 (25%) izinhlobo zezinkuni zokushisa, ezingu-50 (21%) izitshalo ezisetshenziswa ngokuthanda komphakathi kanye ne-1 (0.4%) enenkani.
Ukuhleleka komathirisi okuqondile kwembule ukuthi i-Cordia Africana itholakala njengomkhiqizo osabalalele obalulekile ngokwamasiko kule ndawo, futhi oseyingozi kakhulu, kulandela i-Ficus sur.
I-Cordia africana enenani eliphezulu lokusetshenziswa yayiyile yokwakha, kanti elenani eliphezulu ohlwini yayiyile yokwelapha.
I-Sorensen index yokufana kwaba ngu-64% yezindawo ezahlolwe yayingaphansi kuka-0.5.
Umphumela ubonise ukuthi amagadini asemakhaya yizinhlelo zokukhiqiza eziningi, zesikhathi eside.
Ukuphepha kokudla nokugcinwa kobuhlanga buqhubeka nokusekelwa yilwazi lomlando lwabantu bezizwe elixhunyaniswe nemihlambi yabo yasekhaya.

Ukufana okuncane/ukuhlukahluka okukhulu kwezinhlobo endaweni phakathi kwama-kebele kubonise ukuthi kwakukhona ukuhlukahluka okukhulu kwezinhlobo lokhu kwakubangelwa yizimo ezahlukene ze-agroecological phakathi kwama-kebele.
Imiyezo yase-Ethiopia isekela ukuphepha kokudla nokugcinwa kwemvelo.
Abacwaningi bathi abantu abaningi base-Ethiopia bayalima ukudla, izitshalo zokuhlobisa, izitshalo zokwelapha nezitshalo zokondla izilwane, isithunzi noma ukuvikela emagadini abo.
Bahlalulela lezi zihlahla ukuze babone ukuthi zibaluleke kangakanani ekuqinisekiseni ukuphepha kokudla nasekusizeni ukulondoloza imvelo.
Izindawo ezahlukene emhlabeni lonke zigcina izigqila zokudla, ukuze zenze imali nezinye izinjongo zezenhlalo.
Ama-gardens nawo avikeza izitshalo ezibalulekile ezivame ukungabikho noma ezinyamalala kwamanye amazwekazi.
ENaseThiopia, akukho ucwaningo oluningi oluye lwenziwa ngalokho umphakathi ulikhihla ngempela emisebeni yawo.
Kulesifundo, abacwaningi bafuna ukuhlola izitshalo abantu baseGozamin, eNyakatho-Ntshonalanga ye-Ethiopia, ababezihlwanyela emagadini abo nokuthi babezisebenzisela ini.
Bahlonze futhi balinganisa izitshalo emagadini angu-357 kule ndawo.
Baphethisise futhi umphakathi ngalokho abakusebenzisela khona izitshalo.
Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi wonke amagadini eGozamin ayengaphansi kwenkundla eyisikwele esilingana nehektha.
Baqoqe futhi bahlonza izitshalo ezahlukene ezingu-238.
Iningi (83%) lezimila libiwe unyaka wonke, futhi ezimbalwa kuphela (17%) ezaziyizikhathi zesizini.
Imiphumela yabo yakhombisa ukuthi umphakathi wawusebenzisa izitshalo ekudleni, imithi, ukwakha, ukondla izilwane (ukudla kwezilwane), nezinye izindlela zokusebenzisa ngamasiko.
Izitshalo eziningi zazisebenza ngezinjongo ezingaphezu kweyodwa.
Isibonelo, umuthi omkhulu onemahlathi amakhulu aseNyakatho ungase usetshenziswe kwelokwelapha, ukulungisa, ukondla izilwane, ukumthunzi, ukupakisha nokunye ukusetshenziswa kwamasiko.
Ngaphezulu kwengxenye (59%) yemifino yayisetshenziswa ngezinjongo zezemvelo njengoba kubhekene nokuvikela, izihlahla, isithunzi nokuhlobisa.
Abacwaningi bathi lokhu kusize ekuvikeleni imvelo.
Izitshalo zokufakelwa zasisiza nokugcina imikhiqizo yasemapulazini iphephile.
Ngaphezu kwenxenye yesithathu (35%) yemifino yavunwa ukudla, njengokudla okunjengokuthi izithelo, imifino, izitshalo nemifino ecebile ngezinongo.
Kodwa-ke bathi amagadini asemkhakheni ngokuyinhloko ayenikeza izithelo.

Abacwaningi bathi u-35% wezitshalo zasetshenziswa njengalokho kwelapho lesintu lokuthuthukisa impilo yabantu nezilwane, kanti u-21% zasetshenziswa emikhosini nasezintweni zenkolo, ukubhema, izimfumezo nokubhaka.
Ezinye izitshalo (17%) zasetshenziswa njengokudla kwezinkomo, izimvu, neembongolo.
Abanye (24%) basebenzisa njengezinto zokwakha, ukwenza amathuluzi okusanhlamvu, ukumboza amasango kanye nokwenza izintambo.
Njengoba iningi labantu basemakhaya kubikwe ukuthi basebenzisa izinkuni, u-25% wezitshalo zasetshenziswa ngalokho.
Abacwaningi bathi yisitshalo esisodwa kuphela (0.4%) esikhulunywe ngenhloso yokubulala ngubisi.
Baphinda bathi indlela izitshalo ezazisabalala ngayo kule ndawo yayithonywe yimvelo, lokho abantu ababenzela ukudla, kanye nesimo sezimali somndeni nezidingo zebhizinisi.
Isibonelo, indawo ebizwa ngokuthi iWenka eyayinamanzi okunisela futhi isondele edolobheni elikhulu, yayinamagadini amaningi futhi ibhalise izitshalo ezahlukene ezingama-130.
Abantu baseWenka nabo babelima futhi banikeza izithelo nemifino emakethe yedolobha.
Ekugcineni, abacwaningi bathi abalimi abaningi babekhetha ukukhulisa izitshalo ezinemisebenzi eminingi.
Abacwaningi bathi imiphumela yabo iqinisekise ukuthi impela abalimi bakhulise inani elikhulu lezinhlanga ezahlukene zezitshalo emagadini abo, futhi ngezinjongo ezahlukene.
Ngaphandle kokuthi laba bacwaningi bathole ukuthi abalimi abaningi bakhulise izimila zokwelapha, abanye abacwaningi bathi izihlahla zazivame kakhulu kule ndawo.
Abacwaningi balolu cwaningo babekwiyunivesithi zase-Ethiopia.
